story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった、これが共有の災害だってことに同意できて嬉しいよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: こっちに来て。何を変えたか見せて

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ほら、その行が二回入ってたよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日はそれを見逃しちゃった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 知ってるよ。計算をもう一度確認するように言ったじゃん

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうだね、確認したよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一回

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 三回も、君が私が知らないことを知ってると思ったから

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 教えてくれればよかったのに

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今言ったじゃん

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少し早く言ってれば、時間を節約できたのに

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ次は、君がまだ部屋にいる時に『言ったでしょ』って言えるね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを言う権利は君にあると思うよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君がそう言ったのを覚えておくね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 机の横に立っている二人の被写体

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 二人の距離が近すぎる。仕事だと何度も言い聞かせているのに、あんな姿を見ると胃が締めつけられる。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 近すぎる

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今はここでよりリラックスしているみたいだね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やっぱりね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事のことで？少しだけ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは私が言いたかったこととはちょっと違うよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、もっと具体的に言った方がいいかもね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初の数日間は、何かを持ってくるたびにドアのそばに立ってたよね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だって、いつも忙しそうに見えたから

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は、君も私と同じ数字を見てる時間が半分だってわかったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だから、私はあまり威圧的じゃなくなったってことね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君が威圧的だなんて言ってないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ただ、君はもっと近くに来たくなかっただけでしょ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君が気づく前に座ったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ねえ、こんなに仕事があるのに、君はよく気づくね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気づかないのが難しいこともあるからね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またやってるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何を？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 画面じゃなくて私を見てるでしょ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: スプレッドシートの説明が終わったね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは答えじゃないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そういうつもりじゃなかったんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当にこれを簡単にしてくれないね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何を簡単にするの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 遅すぎた、感じちゃった 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事中なのに真顔を保つのが大変なんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し後に、書類が終わったら...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日の約束、まだ大丈夫？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 飲み物のこと？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、飲み物のこと

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 行くって言ったよね？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事の後は疲れてるかもって言ったよね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 多分疲れるけど、この椅子じゃないところに座れるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 数本先にお店があるよ。7時頃でどう？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 7時で大丈夫だよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本気で聞くけど、痛いの？それともただ awkward なだけ？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: それが賢い選択だったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if it means more work
He’s going to help me deeply this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 今回は彼がしっかり手伝ってくれるみたい。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 心配してくれてありがとうね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 結局、試験を受けなきゃいけないみたい。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼は、そうしないと卒業証書がもらえないってはっきり言ってたよ。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: うん…でも、解決策があるかもって言ってたよね？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼ともっと時間を過ごさないと、試験のためにね。
ハイリー: 追加のセッションとか、そんな感じかな

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: それは良かった。気が変わってくれて嬉しいよ。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: やっほー❤️ 家に着いたよ、真剣な映画の前に夕食を作ろうとしてる

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼について話す必要はないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は後半にも出てこなかったし

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その時の情報を元に頑張ってたんだよ😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君はすごく自信満々だったね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I trusted the scarf too much
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: スカーフを信じすぎちゃった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どんな優れた探偵でも犯しそうなミスだね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 笑うのはやめて、少なくとも映画は約束通りひどかったでしょ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはちゃんと実現したね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、君と一緒に見る方が楽しかったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の解説付きでも？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 未来のあなたはいつも文句を言う何かを見つけるよね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 特に君の解説があったからね❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: こういうのが恋しかった、君とくだらない話をするのが

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: またやろうよ、でも次は君が選んでね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜君の探偵キャリアが終わったのは私のせいじゃないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 無敗で引退するよ、ありがとう😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは違うよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが私の言い分だから

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もっといい映画を見せられる前に寝るね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今の私が皿洗いを放置した時だけだよ😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君もね、ハンサム❤️ 今日は君の足が少し楽だったみたいでよかった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大好きだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたも大好き ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみなさい ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみなさい

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今のところどれくらい作ったの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 鍋一つ、ボウル一つ、スプーン一つ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして、最初のスプーンをどこかおかしなところに置いてしまったから二つ目のスプーンも

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 素晴らしい効率だね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の傑作を見たら、笑えなくなるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら、ちゃんとした食べ物があって、火事の心配もないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それ、美味しそうだね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Attempting doesn't sound promising
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 作ろうとしてるって、あんまり期待できないね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 味もいいし、ちょっと疑わしいくらいだよ😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 二つ目のスプーンは何に貢献したの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 精神的サポートだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次回料理する時に覚えておくね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜ちゃんと食べた？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、食べたし、ソファに座ってるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかったね❤️ 残りを片付けたら追いつくよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今、食事の準備してるの？本当に変わったね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これに慣れないで、明日出かけるからやってるだけだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ああ、それについて話そうと思ってたんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 空の鍋を火にかけそうになって、パスタを棚に置きっぱなしにしちゃった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この前言ってた同僚と？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My manager, actually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 実は、私のマネージャーだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたのマネージャー？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、今日もその話をしたよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 前は同僚って言ってたよね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はやったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 誰のことを指していたのか、もっとはっきり言うべきだったね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他に誰か行くの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, just us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいえ、私たちだけだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいスタートだね😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 仕事の後に飲みに行くだけだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どこ？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: オフィスから数本の通りのところにバーがあるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7時頃だから、仕事からそのまま行くよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それで、行きたいの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、行きたいよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今週はほとんど授業から仕事、そして家に帰るだけだったから

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その3つのこと以外のことをしたいな

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 出かけたい気持ちはわかるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まずは水から始めたら？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: マネージャーと二人で出かけるのは、私が想像してたのとはちょっと違うな

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どう聞こえるかはわかってるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 特に、彼があなたを違う目で見てるって言ってたからね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことを大げさにするべきじゃなかったかも

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが気になったから教えてくれたんでしょ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それには驚いたよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、彼のそばにいるときは不快に感じないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はあなたが誰かと付き合ってるって知ってるの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、知ってるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これを議論にしたくないんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 水はあるよ、全然迷ってないから

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もそう思う

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ただ、私が聞いているのが話の半分だけだと知りたくないんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知ってるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、どこに行くか、誰と行くかを教えてるんだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 着いたらメッセージするね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それで、あなたが帰ったら？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もあなたと一緒に過ごしたいんだからね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食は何？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってるよ。メッセージを待つだけじゃなくて、あなたに会いたいんだ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もあなたが恋しいよ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次の数日でいつ終わるか確認して、何か計画しよう

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはいいね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、私が鍋のそばに立っている間に、私たちの夜が消えてしまうのは嫌だな

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 着替えてリラックスするから、その後はこのひどい映画のためにあなたのものだよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 準備するね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し後で...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい、残り物を片付けて着替えたよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: パスタ、トマトソース、そして今週生き残ったチーズ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 仕事の服も、目の前の皿も、数字もないよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初のスプーン見つけた？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was in the bowl the entire time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ずっとボウルの中にあったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course it was
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろんそうだったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その情報は君に任せるから、優しくしてね😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ソファのいい場所を確保しちゃったよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今、そこにいたいな

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君のためのスペースもあるよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その毛布でソファの半分を占領してるじゃん

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 定番だね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 毛布は分けるけど、いいクッションは譲れないよ😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 太っ腹な提案だね

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'd take it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君はそれを受け入れるでしょ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I would
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、そうするよ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Soon ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すぐにね❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you at the beginning of the film?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 映画の最初の方にいるの？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Paused at the first frame
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初のフレームで一時停止中

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, three, two, one... play
After the film...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 映画の後に...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それで、赤いスカーフの男についてだけど

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日の分も作ってるから、未来の私が文句言えないようにね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 十分なHAKポイントが貯まったよ
新しいスキルが利用可能: ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 興味のある人を監視して、他の場所での会話をキャッチするよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: あなたのコメントなしでも十分ストレス感じてるから
ただ言ってるだけだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 昨日は特定の写真を送ってきたのに

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今日は責任感のある学生みたいに成績を待ってるんだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 結果が出たらメッセージするね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今日、成績が出るはずだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 人脈のある家庭教師がいると、いいことがあるよね😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: でも前ほどじゃないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ねえ😊 ギプスなしの初めての朝、どう感じる？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そして、私はそれに真っ直ぐぶつかってしまった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: これを可能にしてくれてありがとう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: どういたしまして、残念ながら😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも、真面目に、快適？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ほとんどね。起き上がるとまだ硬い感じがする

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 道を全速力で走る準備はできてないかな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 良かった、だって追いかけるつもりはなかったから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ちょっとも？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: すごくがっかりした顔で君の後を歩くよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 待って、これが君が見る顔だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 実は変な感じ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 怖い

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君には効くね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当にそうだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: やっと外れて嬉しいよ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨日君のメッセージを見たとき、抱きしめに行きたかった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そのオファー、まだ有効？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 明らかに

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも、君の足について聞かずに過ごす午後も欲しいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私が元気になったら、どこかの小さなカフェを見つけよう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 起きたら、まだそれのために布団を動かさなきゃって思った

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それ、いいね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君の向かいに座って、君の皿から何かを盗むのが恋しい

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 美しい。それが私のことを恋しく思う理由だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 他にも色々あるけどね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも主に、私よりも美味しそうなものを頼むその悪い癖ね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いつもお腹が空いてないって言うよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたの料理が来るまではお腹が空いてないの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 全然違う状況だよ😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 食べ物の話だけど、朝ごはんは食べた？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: コーヒー

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それに愛着が湧いちゃったね😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは飲み物だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 急に責任感が出てきたね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: とても厳しい女性から学んだんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素敵な人そうだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うざいけど、すごく美人だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それがあなたを救ったね❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 待って、私が食べてる証拠を見せるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: トーストとコーヒー、そしてあなたにメッセージを送り続けたら絶対遅れる女性

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一緒にたくさんの時間を過ごしたから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素敵に見えるよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: トーストに気づいてほしかったのに

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 両方とも気づいたよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは許可するよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一日中授業なの？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今朝は、昼食の後にグループで作業があるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨日、みんながすでに持っている書類を誰が送るか決めるのに20分もかかったよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いいスタートだね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その通り。お菓子持って行くし、期待値下げておくね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君だけが準備万端みたいだね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私、嫉妬すべき？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 感情的には、全然ダメだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それに、昨晩話したことは忘れてないからね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう一つの靴を探している時じゃなくて、ちゃんと最初のステップを考えたいんだ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 靴と競争するのは嫌だな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今のところ靴が勝ってるね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 見つけた！両方の靴履いたから、もう言い訳できないね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 出発する前に最後の写真を撮るね、だって君がここにいて私を気を散らせられないから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君が出発するように励ますのがすごく難しいよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: すごく支え合う関係だったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私に幸運を祈るべきなのに、私を寂しくさせるなんて。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 両方できるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君ならできるって知ってるよ ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 静かな時間ができたら、メッセージしてね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、するよ ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そのハグのために、スケジュールに少し余裕を持っておいてね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ソファとの約束はキャンセルするね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そいつにごめんって伝えてね😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ああ、もう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それ、昨日から温めてたでしょ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 医者がそれを外してから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 私の小さな生徒がちゃんと勉強したんだ
これのために苦労したよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: その途中で面白いご褒美ももらったじゃん
それはモチベーションって言うんだ😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 一番大事な試験には合格したから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: だから、あまり勉強しなくても大丈夫なんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 残りの試験も合格した方が安全だよ。イーサンをもう少し引き留めるのはウィンウィンだし。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 十分頑張ったから、しばらくは本以外のことをする時間かもね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 本当に試験のことだけなのかな…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: それとも、イーサンに会い続けてほしいだけなの？😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: あなたの卒業証書のことを考えてるだけだよ
なんて高尚なことなんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: たまにはいい人になれるからね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: でも、そういう時は正しいよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 次の試験のためにイーサンをキープするね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 君が幸せになるのは間違いないよ
{{name:aiden}}がまたトレーニングセッションを始めたよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 何週間も勉強にこもってるじゃん

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ちょっと動くくらいは悪くないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 特に夏に向けて体をキープしたいならね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 気をつけて、私は小さいけどちゃんとお前を倒せるからね😌
実際、君の言う通りだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: また動きたい気分だし
そんなに満足そうにしないでよ😱
あなたはもっと頑張るべきだ
もちろん、そうするよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やっと誰かにグループプロジェクトのことを聞かれずに食べる時間ができたよ😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 確かに、もっと情報があったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 厳しいね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 的確だね 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、何かを考える助けにはなったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まずは普通に誰かと話せるようになりたいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 新しいことに挑戦するからって、適当に誰かを選びたくないんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君にもそんなことしてほしくないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それに、私が付き合ってるって知ってほしいの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話の途中で大事なことを隠してる気分になりたくないんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 同意だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: プロフィールを真面目な発表みたいに聞こえないように書くのが難しいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まずは「こんにちは」から始めて。彼氏の堅苦しい紹介は省いてもいいよね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: え、まだ準備してないの？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 参考文献を入れてもいいけど。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 絶対にダメだよ😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、私が書いたものは読んでほしいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰かを選んでほしいわけじゃないの。ただ、これが新しいから、一人でやるのはちょっと寂しいなって思って。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろん

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 知らない人の方が簡単かもって言ったけど、最初に返事した人を信じなきゃいけないって意味じゃないからね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 知ってるよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 日当たりのいい場所を見つけたね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 友達の前で気まずくないからって、彼と一緒にいて楽だとは限らないよね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その通り

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だから今夜、何かを書いて普通の写真を選ぶね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日、投稿して会話を始めるのが嬉しいかどうか決められるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それ、ちゃんとした計画っぽいね！

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっと緊張する計画だけど、うん。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは許可されてるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ひどいプロフィールについて文句を言う権利もあるからね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その部分は疑いようがなかったよね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、私のランチはプレゼンテーションについて一つも質問してこなかったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好奇心を持っていることを認めるのが難しいと思ってた。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は、自分らしくない感じで会話を始める方法を考えてる。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 急に自信満々の人になる必要はないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは良かった、だって私はまだ食べ物を注文する前に電話の練習をしてるから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それで、代わりに電話するように言うんでしょ？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だって、あなたが私を愛してるから 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 残念ながら、私の電話料金には厳しいけど

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これ、試してみたいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初の一歩は、私が選んだって感じにしたいの。いい会話があったからって、急いで決めたくないの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最高の相手だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、そこから始めよう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 戻らなきゃ。スライドについて話す理由がまた見つかったみたい

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 頑張ってね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 残りのランチを持っていくね。今はそれだけが信頼できるものだから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 次回は招待するよ。ただし、自分のフライドポテトを持ってきてね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日のことを考えてたんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 主に、最初に何をするのが自分にとって快適かについて

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何か進展あった？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。君が何を望んでいるか考えているだけよりは少し進んだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 脱出できた？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}のことを言ったことで、普通のことが少し特別に感じられるようになったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どんなこと？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が前回の授業のノートを持っているか聞いてきたの。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 普段ならすぐに送るんだけど。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日はそのメッセージをバカみたいに長い間見つめて、彼が本当に授業のノートを求めていることを思い出すまで時間がかかったの。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: お願い、彼に謎めいた返事を送ってないよね？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ううん😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一時的にね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はノートを手に入れたよ。すごくワクワクする展開だね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっと落ち着いて、先走りすぎだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うるさい！

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、それが問題なの。彼はもう私の日常の一部なんだ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これについて話して変な感じになったとしても、キャンパスで彼に会うことになるから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。次の普通のランチのことはあまり考えてなかった。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だからって、彼と話さないべきだとは思わないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ただ、彼をゲームに誘うみたいには扱いたくないんだ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかりました

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ランチが必要だって言ったら、誰かが食べてる間にスライドについて話せるかって聞いてきたの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どうやってそれを切り出したい？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まずは二人きりで。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 友達が聞いている中で個人的なことを説明するより、ちょっと気まずい会話の方がいいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それに、誰も求めていないアドバイスをすることになりそうだし。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 正確に

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 待って

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が来るよ。ちょっと時間ができたらメッセージするね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: しばらくして

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここに誰か座ってる？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どうかな。私のランチを盗みに来たの？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: スライドを投げつけたの？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰かがテーブルに加わる

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話中

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 予期しない席

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ノートのことを聞こうと思ってたけど、ランチの話をしたから…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ノートを手に入れたね。今日はそれがあなたへのプレゼントだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 相変わらず気前がいいね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 大丈夫？さっきは遠くを見てたみたいだったけど

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。ちょっと考え事してた

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何か手伝えることある？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 多分。静かな時に話したいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話が続く

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他の話者に注意が向けられる

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 考えたけどね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 言いたいことがある

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ああ。わかった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そんなに心配しないで、悪いことじゃないから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君がそう言うまでは心配してなかったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やばい、今はドラマチックに聞こえちゃった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 準備ができたら教えてね。感謝を伝えに来ただけだから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: メモのため？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを書き留めていなかったことを認めるのを助けてくれてありがとう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あ、いたいた。なんでそんなに優しいのかと思ってた

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何かを求めずに優しくできるよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも外のテーブルを見つけたから、自己成長を選んだの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、私のフライドポテトから手を離して

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 確かにその通り

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: テーブルでの遊び心満載のやり取り

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 笑い合った

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女が笑っていると知るのは嬉しい。二人が一緒にいることには、まだ慣れている途中だけど。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ランチの交渉

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よし、また自分の電話を持てるようになった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 大丈夫？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。普通の会話をしただけだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 言いかけたけど、隣に人がいたからね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は私が何かについて話したいことを知ってる。でも、何かは知らない

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたを誇りに思います

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはどうだった？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 思ったより怖くなかった

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が私のランチを盗もうとしたから、あまり真剣には受け取れなかったけど

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それ、聞いたことあるな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日、もう少し静かな瞬間を見つけるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他のことを決める前に、実際に話せるか見てみたい

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった。今夜の気分を教えて

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私は

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ありがとう 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 休憩中にアプリをダウンロードしたよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どんな感じか見たくてね。プロフィールも作ってないし、誰にもメッセージ送ってないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっと待って、プロフィール画面に戻る方法を思い出そうとしてるの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: しばらくして

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あ、見つけた！

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 画面の男たちを大きな人生の決断みたいに考えるのをやめたら、ちょっと気が楽になったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何か面白い発見あった？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ある男は同じ車の横で自分の写真を6枚も載せてたよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その車、いい性格してるのかもね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これが私の超特別なランチスポットだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: でも今警告しておくよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 家族でも、他の人と同じ扱いだからね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 彼女にはちゃんとした人が必要だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 真剣にならないといけない人の話をしてる間に…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 怠けてたら君の足は治らないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 医者にギプスを外してもらったのは昨日だぞ、覚えてる？
そして私は目があるからね😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 本格的なセッションが始まったら泣かないでよ
{{name:hailey}}に準備しておくように言っておくね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: トレーニングセッションに参加したいって

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: I might have given her a little push
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: ちょっと後押ししたかも

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ 😊 ソファからの壮大な冒険は実現した？それとも、ゲーム機が勝ったの？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: たぶんすぐにはね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だからこそ、直接話したいの。必要なら冗談をやめるように言えるし

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が彼の名前をどれだけ早く言ったかは言わないでね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すぐにってこと？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう言うと余計悪く聞こえるよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その詳細は省いておくよ😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私たちのメッセージも見せないよ。自分で状況を説明できるから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ありがとう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから彼がどう感じるか見てみるね。その会話ができる前に彼をどこにも誘わないから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 時間ができたら、どうしてるか教えてね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから家に帰って、夕食を作ったら、6人家族分のパスタを作ってしまったことに気づいたの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、するよ ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: さっき短い自己紹介を書いたんだけど、読む？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 送ったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私は付き合ってる人がいて、ここにいることも知ってるの。誰かと知り合いたいから、まずは会話から始めて、コーヒーでもどうかな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはあなたの言いたいことを言ってるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あまり堅苦しくない？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少しね。私たちに関係ない自分のことを追加してみて

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 偶然にパスタを6人分作る才能のこと？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日の食事はこれで決まりだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 正直に言うと、そうだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 静かなカフェ、ひどい映画、そして存在しない人のために料理するのが好きなんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはもっと君らしいね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: パスタには君も入ってるから、心配しないでね😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと待って、今の光がいいうちに一枚撮りたいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 完全に偏りのない意見を言うようにするね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは初めてだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、これ本当に私に似てる

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして、もしかしたら残りの人生もね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が一つだけフライドポテトを盗んだって言うときの私の表情だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私は無邪気に見えるけど、本当に無邪気なんだ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 写真は素晴らしいね。でも、法的な防御はもう少し頑張らないと。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、その写真は私がもらうね😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを使って、明日もう一度イントロを読んでから何か投稿するね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そしたら、実際に話したい人がいるかどうか見てみるね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: メッセージが来たからって、誰かに会話をする義務はないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってるよ。好奇心はあるけど、ネット全体からの応募は受け付けてないから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはいいプロフィールタイトルだね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう助けになってないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次は持ってきてくれるといいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日がちょっと緊張するな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、準備しようとしている大きな飛躍じゃなくて、実際にやりたい小さなことがあるのがいいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もし思ってたのと違う感じになったら教えてね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたも

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君がそれを持ち出したからって、無理して大丈夫だって思わないでほしいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はしない。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: さて、すごく大事な質問があるんだけど。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の問題を解決してくれるなんて、さすがね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 聞いています

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私がパスタを持って行ったとき、ちゃんとした映画を見るの？それとも、また誰も明かりをつけない映画を見るの？
