story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが雰囲気ってもんだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは、ドアのところに誰が立ってるのかを2時間聞くことになるよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今回は君が選んでいいよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。でも、文句を言う権利は留保するからね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が文句を言わなかったら心配だよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君と過ごすその午後が欲しいんだ、わかるでしょ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: また真面目な話をするためじゃなくて、ただ食べ過ぎて君の隣に座っていたいだけなんだ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと待って、また気を散らされる前にリラックスさせて

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もそれが欲しいよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、忘れないでね。私はまだソファの場所を確保してるから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは君のだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと待って、ここで寝ちゃう前にソファからベッドに移動するね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい、もう一つの枕を君のために取っておくね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君がどれだけ恋しいか、全然助けになってないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、来れるときに取りに来てね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 行くよ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5分後

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ、ハンサム ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ。パスタを少し取っておいてね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私たち二人よりも長持ちするパスタがあるよ。寝てね😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい、髪はまだ濡れてるけど、もう動かないから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 寝そうな顔してるよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: キッチンに行って戻ってきたよ、何回もね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことないよ。さっき座ったばかりだから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だいたいそんな感じで始まるんだよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 面白いね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 実は明日までに確認したいことがあるの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どうぞ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この前の夜、他の誰かに写真を送ったら何を知りたいか聞いたよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの答えは覚えてるけど、私たちがするかもしれないこと全てをカバーしてるとは思いたくないの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは正当だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 経験豊富な旅人だね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは知りたいし、写真も受け取りたいって言ったよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、あなたが共有することに私も含まれるのが好きだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった。でも、誰かと話してる時はずっと携帯を見てるわけじゃないからね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5分ごとにアップデートを求めてるわけじゃないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もしあなたが共有することに決めたら、その写真を見たいな。会話はまた別だし

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね。私が打ってないからって、メッセージを待って何かが間違ってると思ってほしくないの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 暇な時に教えて、そしたらちゃんと話せるから

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 外にもちょっと時間があったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それの方がいいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ写真にあまり期待しないでね。最初の会話すらしてないから😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はとても我慢強いよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それっぽく見せてるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知りたいって言ったけど、必ずしも自分で写真が欲しいわけじゃないよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。それはまだ合ってるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたから聞きたいな。私に見せるために何かを集める必要はないよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 正直、それは安心だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから、野心を後悔する前に座ったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何があったかを証明するより、どう感じたかを伝えたいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 宿題をチェックしてるわけじゃないからね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかった。今日はもうそれは十分だよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もし忙しいなら、後で話そうね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった。携帯で別の会話を続けるより、時間ができたら教えるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その通り

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちなみに、普通の写真も送るからね。私の顔からは逃げられないよ😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 逃げるつもりはなかったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それ、実際に理にかなってるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知りたくないかもしれないって言ったよね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それぞれのことを知らないってこと？それとも、起こっている間に更新がないってこと？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを頭の中で分けて考えてなかったよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから聞いてるんだよ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: サプライズの余地を残すのは理解できるよ。ただ、私たちが気づかずに違うことを考えているのは避けたいな

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 限界について合意しよう。でも、いくつかのことはサプライズにしておこう

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その時は更新なしで、後で話したいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まず何を試すか決めてから、細かいことは教えなくてもいいスペースを残したいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった。私たちが実際に話したことの中でのサプライズがいいな、どこまでその答えが行くのかを推測するのは嫌だから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その通り

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 驚いてるみたいだね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今は、連絡を取り合って、初デートが合うかどうかだけを話してるんだ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってるよ。これが他のことに全部合意したみたいには扱ってないから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もし何かが違和感があったら、ちゃんと伝えるよ。ミステリーを守るためにそれを自分だけに留めておくつもりはないから。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん。私も同じだよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、今はもっと理解できたよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その時に全てを追いかけるのは避けたいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、その後にどうだったか、君がどう感じたかを聞きたいな。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、携帯を置いて会話を楽しんで、暇な時に話そう。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この瞬間を台無しにしないようにしてるの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、それが私の言いたかったことに近いね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった。そうするよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もし早く君と話す必要があれば、ちゃんとするからね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん。君が必要な時に計画に縛られる必要はないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 良い ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今それについて話せてよかった。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分が携帯を見て、何か送るべきかどうか考えてる姿を想像してた。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことで心配してほしくないよ。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの残りの一日はどうでしたか？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってる。実際に言ったから、今は楽になったね。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、明日何をしたい？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}に授業の後に少し話せるか聞いてみるね

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他の誰かとデートすることについて話してたって説明したいの

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その人とその話をすることも考えてるってこと

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は本気だって信じてくれると思う？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: プロジェクトの私たちの部分が終わったから、やっと考えなくて済むよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 本当に私を忙しくさせようとしてるね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 昨夜のことを考えると、そんな提案するとは思わなかったけど
シンプルなのはいいね
でも、あなたが袋を持つのよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: あんまり時間かけないでね、そうしたら私が先に始めちゃってジャンクフードだけ買っちゃうから
あなたはもっと頑張るべきだ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 同じページを20分も見つめてる
今夜はタコス作ろうよ
買い物 + 手作りタコス。どう？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 私と一緒に料理するってこと？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: おはよう❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 彼女は永久的な招待状を持ってるから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: いいね。それを覚えておいてね🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 昨日の足の具合はどう？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 起きたときは少し硬かったけど、少し動いたら良くなったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私たちが止まったときは良かったと思う

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私も。今朝はのんびりするつもりだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 何を計画してるの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 今朝は家のことをいくつかやって、その後は多分ゲームをするつもり

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 君はどうするの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 午後は家族と過ごす予定だよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: バッグに手を伸ばして、どこにあるか思い出したよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: まずはランチ。その後、どうやらカードをするらしい

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: どうやら？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 知らされたよ。私の参加は選択肢じゃなかったからね😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: プライドを保ったままで帰ってきてね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: もっと高い目標を目指すよ。勝つつもりだから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: その意気だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: それから、彼らに私を称賛させてあげるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: とても優雅だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: その通り

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: うん、準備しなきゃ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: まだソファの横にあるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私のバッグを安全に保っててね。会ったときに取りに行くから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: もちろん！今日は楽しんでね❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: あなたもね、愛してる

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 少なくとも、私たちのうちの一人は昨晩君の家に泊まれたね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 君のバッグは静かな相手だったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: じゃあ、それにあまり執着しないでね😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: もう遅いよ。私たちはもう朝ごはんを食べたから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私抜きで？失礼だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 代わりに招待すべきだった人はこちらだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: さあ、キッチンで手伝ってよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ただ見てるだけはダメだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: しばらくして、キッチンで料理した後
実は、切るのが結構上手だね
ちょっと感心してるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 私はまだ調味料の管理をしてるからね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: あなたが一番散らかしてるのにね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: そして、無駄なものを3つだけ買った

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 顔にソースつけてる時に？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: タコスのスパイスまみれの私にそんなこと言っちゃダメ！
その写真は残しておくけどね
一緒に普通のことをするの
昨日のことを考えると…軽く感じる

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 私がこんなに落ち着いてるのに慣れないでね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: タコスがもうすぐできるからこうなんだ
食べ物が全てを解決する
特にぎこちない会話はね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: さあ、話すのはやめて、盛り付け手伝って！

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: クッキーが変な目で見てきたから
実際、すごく美味しかった！

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 煙探知機をほとんど鳴らさなかった時に10を取っておくよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: あなたが煙探知機をほとんど鳴らさなかった時のことね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: とにかく…片付けてから寝るね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 思ったより助かったよ
そんなに早く言わないでよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 毎週タコスナイトをリクエストしちゃうかも

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: とにかく…片付けてから寝るね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 少なくとも1つの袋を持ってた証拠だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: アップデート：ランチは最高だったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: お母さんによろしく言っといてね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 彼女からキスが返ってきたよ😘
助けて
何が起こってるの？
もうすぐカードが終わるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: でも、嬉しそうに見えると、誰かがもっと引かせるのよ
じゃあ、嬉しそうに見えないようにしなよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 手がひどいふりをしてみて
それがあなたの素晴らしいアドバイスなの？
彼らにあなたを過小評価させておきなよ
カードが大惨事だよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: わかった。私の評判をあなたに託すよ
数分後
また負けちゃった

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 真顔を保ってた？
約10秒間ね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: そしたら、誰かが「なんで犯罪を隠してるみたいな顔してるの？」って聞いてきた
だから、ブラフは改善が必要だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 新しいアドバイザーが必要かも

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 厳しいな。限られた情報でやってたんだから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 誰にずっとメッセージ送ってるのか聞かれた
もう？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 専門家の助けを受けてるって言ったの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 彼氏が私を負けさせる手伝いをしてるって言ったよ
それは痛いな
正確だから痛いんだよね😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 彼らにあなたを恋しく思わせるチャンスをあげなよ。休憩しな

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: そうしてるよ。もう一切れケーキを取ってくるね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: デザートでは勝ってるからいいけどね
素晴らしい回復だね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 今日は午後遅くに帰るね
今夜は空いてる？
2回も負けちゃった
うん。どうしたの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: いいアイデアがあるよ。帰ったら教えるね❤️
今、気になるなぁ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: いいよ。まずは超重要なケーキを終わらせるね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 私が勝ちそうになると、みんな急に競争心を燃やすのよ
あなたも？
それは違うよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 不公平に扱われてる人の顔を見てみて

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 復讐を企んでるみたいだね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 夜も更けて——家に戻ったあなたは、ひとりで静かな時間を過ごしている。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。あなたと遊びたいな

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたはいつも楽しそうに聞こえる

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ただ聞くだけじゃなくて、あなたと一緒にやってみたいと思ったの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、二人とも楽しめる何かを見つけよう

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたが言ってたレースゲームはどう？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それいいね。プライベートレースができるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いいよ。でも、まずは操作方法を教えてね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 了解。準備ができたら招待するね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 少し後 — 二人でレースゲームを始める。始める前に、操作方法を説明して、{{name:lena}}に練習ラップを試させる。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ただいま

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 準備完了。私の集中力を評価してね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: とてもプロフェッショナルだね。練習ラップはどう？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 同じ壁に三回ぶつかったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: コーナーの前でブレーキをかけて、次に曲がって

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: フルスピードで両方やろうとしてるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: スピードがポイントだと思ってた

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 道を外れないことも大事だよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: わかった。もう一回練習ラップしよう

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 最初のレースの後

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それと、すごく真剣な質問があるの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたは私よりずっと先にゴールしたね😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私はもっとプレイしてるから。あなたの初めてのレースと比べないで

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も逆向きになって動けなくなったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: でも、最後のコーナーはきれいに曲がれたじゃん

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それは練習中にずっとぶつかってたやつだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それに気づいたよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ほら？もうタイミングが掴めてるじゃん

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: オッケー。もう一回

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 同じコース？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。まだやり残したことがあるの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 聞いてるよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 二回目のレースの後 — {{name:lena}} はまだあなたの後ろでゴールしたけど、クラッシュは少なくてコースを完走したよ。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: まだ負けちゃった

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: でも、タイムを確認してみて

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 初めのレースよりずっと早くゴールしたね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それに、私は2回しか回らなかったよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: その通り。鋭いコーナーの前で減速するのを覚えてたね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたの指示を頭の中で繰り返してたの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 効果あったよ。ずっと良いラップだった

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私が彼女だから優しくしてくれてるの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 上達してなかったら、そう言うよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜、何か一緒に遊ばない？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 速いラップは君が上手く運転したからだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん、それはいい答えだね❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: やめる？それとも別のコースを試す？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: これであと一回

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 全くクラッシュせずにできるか試してみたいの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 最後のレースの後

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もう少しだったのに

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 最後にバリアにちょっと当たっただけだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 興奮しすぎてブレーキを忘れちゃったの

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 前半は本当に良かったよ。それを続ければ、後はついてくるから

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: え、私に遊んでほしいって言ってるの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 別の日にリマッチしたいな

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それはすごく嬉しいよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私が聞いたことについてまだニヤニヤしてるでしょ？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ちょっとね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: これを君と共有できるのが好きだよ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も。君が捕まえるのが面倒くさいくらい難しくても

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: これで私がいつももう一回やりたがる理由がわかったでしょ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 残念ながら、そうだね😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 子供の頃、こんなゲームをしてた？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。コントローラーを横に傾けて、曲がるのに役立つと思ってた

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜もそれをやったよ😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、君は素晴らしい本能を持ってるね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: どうやら車以外はみんな私が何を望んでいるか理解してたみたい

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 次回は車も巻き込むようにしよう

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜は私に辛抱強く接してくれてありがとう

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 楽しかったよ。君が勝たなくても、一緒に遊ぶのは楽しめるからね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も楽しかったよ ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。明日の準備して、寝るね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: おやすみ、愛しい人。遊ぼうって誘ってくれてありがとう

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: おやすみ ❤️ またやろうね

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: なんでそんなに驚いてるの？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたが提案することなんてないじゃん。いつも私がゲームの話をしてるのに

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 実は、あなたが聞いてくれてすごく嬉しい

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 一緒に買い物行かない？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 新しいズボンが必要なんだ。二日前に医者がギプスを外してくれたから、やっとまたサイズの合うズボンを履ける。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 学業の罪悪感なしで家を出る理由をずっと待ってたの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: もう30分ちょうだい、もうちょっとマシに見えるようにするから。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 私抜きで始めないでね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yeah. How are you feeling today?
Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: まだちょっと疲れてるけど、頭は完全にスープじゃなくなったよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: いいね。次はいつ教授に会うの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 多分、二日に一回くらいかな。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: たまに毎日、必要だと思ったらね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 彼、”追加セッション”をかなり真剣に受け止めてるみたい。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ 私たちはその映画を見なかったことにすることにしたよ、私の評判はまだ無傷だし。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: よかった、私だけじゃなかったんだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたはどうだった？いい夜だった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ずっと良かったよ、起きて携帯を見る前に朝ごはんを作ったんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 落としたものの跡を残さずに？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: スプーンが一つだけ落ちたけど、拾ったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたのとても野心的な朝を誇りに思うよ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 靴も両方履いたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 座ってるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 座ってるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ほら、教えられることもあるんだね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 探偵さん、おはよう。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 朝ごはんはどう？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大丈夫だけど、バッグを詰めるのが問題なんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨夜のパスタを持っていくよ、またサンドイッチに盗まれないように

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 未来のあなたがそのディナーからやっと何か得たね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼女は食べ物とすごくいっぱいのバッグを手に入れたね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 食べ物を上に置いて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そしたら本を持たなきゃいけないんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本を持って

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたがこのジッパーを閉めようとしていないときは、すべてが簡単に聞こえるね😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 家に何か置いていけるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 始めないで、まだ朝ごはんも食べてないんだから😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 全部必要なんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 三週間も底にあったものも含めて？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 底に何があるか知らないでしょ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そう思う？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それがポイントじゃないんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 待って、わかったかも

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ギリギリの時間前に服を着て準備できてることを評価してね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当に素敵に見えるよ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、ハンサム😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 赤いスカーフを持って行ったら、気分が良くなるかな？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: バッグが戦いに負けそうに見えるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 女の子を褒めて、荷物じゃなくて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その女の子は素敵だね。荷物には同情するよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ずっと良くなったね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今朝も授業あるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、その後すぐに仕事だよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 最後の1時間、時計を見つめずにすべてを終わらせたいな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 妥当な目標だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は何をするの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 避けていたキッチンの戸棚を片付けるつもりだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 次に私が来たとき、リモコンを隠しちゃうからね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 開けたら物が落ちてくるやつ？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: サプライズ機能だと思うことにするよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 中に入れるものを少なくするって手もあるよね😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いいコーヒーマグのためにスペースを作ってるんだ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大事なこと、初めてのちゃんとしたコーヒーは計量カップから出てほしくないな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: プレゼンテーションが台無しになったじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: コーヒーのために力を温存して、マグはあまり気にしないよ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 近いうちに君を連れ出したいな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それ、いいね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: じゃあ、早く着く前に出発しないとバスを逃しちゃうからね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは告白みたいだね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は午後あまり携帯を触らないかも

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: せっかく頑張ったんだから、ランチを忘れないでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう脇に食い込んできてるから、忘れることなんてできないよ😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今夜バーに着いたら、言った通りに連絡するね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、良い一日を

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君もね、ハンサム❤️ 大好きだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私も愛してるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは警告みたいだね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 少なくとも、よく眠れた？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、実際の結末がどうなっているのか考えるのをやめたらね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうじゃなかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 二つ目はあんまり悲惨じゃないね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks for the vote of confidence
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 自信を持たせてくれてありがとう
正直に言ってるだけだよ、意地悪じゃないから。
そうだね、Bの方がいいよね
ほら、私のセンスいいでしょ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 入口の近くで素敵なものを見つけたよ
もうメンズコーナーにいるよ
もっと盛り上がってよ！
めっちゃいい感じだね
もう一回試してみるね
最初の方が好きだったな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 見て、ちゃんと目があるじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: その後、支払いしてご飯食べに行こう！

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ バーにいるよ、やっとオフィスチェアじゃないところに座れた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のおすすめをバカにし続けてもいいけど、これが気に入ってるみたいだね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここは本当に好きだよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, that wasn't difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら、そんなに難しくなかったでしょ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これについて一晩中うるさくなるつもりでしょ？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私がいいセンスを持ってることに驚くのをやめるまでだけどね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはあげないよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことしなくていいよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君は？オフィスにいないときは実際に何をしてるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 出かけて、美味しいところを見つけて、暇な日にどこかにドライブに行こう

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 着いたらみんなにどこに座るか教えてくれるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いい感じ、まだあまり混んでないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 誰かがトイレの近くのテーブルを選ぶのを止めないとね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それすら否定しないんだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why would I?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なんで否定する必要があるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが自信なのか、全く恥を知らないのか決められないわ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 決めたら教えてね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 部屋の反対側でミュージシャンがセッティングしている間に...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜ここで演奏するの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks like it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうみたいだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは別の夜の機材だと思ってた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の一杯はもうすぐ終わるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 側の壁の近くに小さなテーブルがあるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私を計ってるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物のメニューを頼むかどうか決めてるところ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここに一つあるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 気づいたんだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一日中残りのパスタを持ち歩いてたの。別のものを見せて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: また君の電話？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm checking the time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 時間を確認してるの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の彼氏が連絡を待ってるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何をしているか彼に知らせるって言ったの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物が美味しいって伝えて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なぜ？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから彼が君がなぜ滞在しているのか分かるように

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ滞在すると言ってないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そのメニューを5分間見てるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もしかしたらお腹が空いてるのかも

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、私と一緒に食べていこうよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった、私も少し音楽を聴きたいな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、私が食べ物を選ぶからね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd say that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう言うと思ったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと待って、彼に知らせるから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはいい感じだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 出発する前に何か食べるつもりだよ、ここでバンドが始まるからね😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、もう少し滞在するの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、今夜ライブ音楽があるなんて気づかなかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何を頼むの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フラットブレッドとフライドポテト、特に洗練されたものじゃないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一晩中ランチを持ち歩くよりはマシだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その容器は今空だから、私の決断をジャッジするのはやめてほしいな😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君はただ飲みに行くだけだと思ってた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もそう思ってたけど、楽しい時間を過ごしてるし、昼食以来何も食べてないの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、椅子が背中を壊そうとしてないのがありがたい

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 家に着いたらまだメッセージするね❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When the food arrives...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物が届いたら...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食、フライドポテトを全部食べる前にね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 美味しそう

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いい匂いだね、熱いうちに食べるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食事を楽しんでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk in a bit ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと後で話そうね❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フライドポテトは今食べてもいいの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you ordered?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう注文した？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一枚だけ写真を撮ったよ、大丈夫だよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私たちの間に電話がない方が良かったよね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大げさにならなくても私の注意を引けるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあそれを置いて試してみて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フラットブレッド？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, the tablecloth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 違う、テーブルクロスだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 話し続けたら、あなたの分も食べちゃうよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 理由があってフライドポテトを多めに頼んだんだから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたにも役に立つところがあるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 気をつけて、それはほぼ別の褒め言葉だよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ、まだ見てるところだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: セットの数曲が終わったところで...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you say?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何て言ったの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: こっちに椅子を移して、テーブル越しに叫びたくないから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 隣に座るように頼めばよかったのに

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今頼んだじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In the most bossy way possible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最も命令口調でね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なのに椅子を動かしてるじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの声が聞こえないから、そんなに嬉しそうにしないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたを止めてるわけじゃないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 足を突っ込む前にバッグを移動させて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、続けてね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その本も椅子を持つの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その本はあなたよりマナーがいいから、椅子が必要だよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}}は音楽の中で彼の声を聞くためにマネージャーの隣に椅子を移動させる

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女は彼に答えるために近づき、手が一瞬彼の前腕に触れる

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼の腕に置かれた手が胸に刺さる。ほんの小さな仕草なのに、二人がどこまで近づくのか考えてしまう。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Little Closer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう少し近くに

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know this one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これ知ってる？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、歌うように頼まないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夜を台無しにするつもりはなかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 失礼だね、私がとても上手かもしれないじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうかもね。私はこれを楽しみすぎて確かめたくないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたはひどい

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the cupboard survive you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食器棚は無事だった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは笑った

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは君が少しもひどくなくなるわけじゃないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここでは君が違うね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6時の時より疲れてない？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が私に話してるとき、ちゃんと目を合わせてくれるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もしかして、君は見つめすぎかも

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like looking at you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君を見るのが好きだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう少し控えめにしてみたら？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうすることもできるけど、意味があるとは思えないな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 気づいたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今はキッチンのあちこちにいくつかの山になってるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう改善されてるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: セットが終わって、皿が片付けられた後...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: バスの時刻を確認しないと

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が会計するね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分の食事代は払えるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が君を招待したんだから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが私が払えないって意味じゃないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜は私が払うってこと

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君はどこでもこんな感じだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 退屈な夜じゃなかったよね？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、それは認めるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、始めたことを後悔してるところなんだね😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを受け入れるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 約20分後にバスが来るよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 時間はたっぷりあるよ。ジャケットを取ってきて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: お願い？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ジャケットを取ってきて、お願い

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら、君も学べるじゃん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Deeply
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 深く後悔してるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 使えるマグは一つは残しておいてね、いい？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 約束はできないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと携帯を置くね、帰ったら連絡するよ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、また後で話そう

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼らのテーブルで、少し後に...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}}の近くでバーの会話が検出されたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 仕事帰りに一杯飲むだけだと言っていた。気にせずいられると信じたいのに、画面を何度も見てしまう。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いい感じだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 1時間前に仕事で私を見たでしょ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物もあるから、かなり勝ってるよ😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その時もいい感じだったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから私のことをずっと見てたの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私がレポートが終わったか確認してると思ったの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうでしょ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The report got finished, didn't it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: レポートは終わったんでしょ？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜は仕事の話はなしだよ
