story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを持ち出したのは君だよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう君が疲れさせるって分かるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが上司に対する話し方なの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の上司が私に何をしたか思い出させる？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 時間通りに終わった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今日はいい天気だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah I thought so
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、そう思ったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 座ってからずっと笑ってるね。チャンスをもらうよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いつもこんなに自分に満足してるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いい夜だからね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've barely started
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ始まったばかりだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その通り

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだね、君の頭が大きくなる前に、何を頼むの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ジンジャーのやつを頼んで、ここは美味しいよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どこに行っても指示を出すの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なんとかね、ランチコンテナを慎重にバッグに戻さなきゃいけなかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分が話してることが分かってる時だけだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ君の意見では、どこでもってこと？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のことを知り始めてるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unfortunately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 残念ながら

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm having the orange one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: オレンジのやつを頼むよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私に反対するためだけに？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だって好きだから。驚きだよね、分かってるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいけど、気が変わった時に私のを頼まないでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 心配しないで、君に満足させるつもりはないから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 飲み物が届いた後...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ本も持ってるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、テーブルはいい選択だったね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: バーもそうだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一つの褒め言葉を受け入れるだけで、他を集める必要はないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なんで一つで止めるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you come here a lot?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここにはよく来るの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: スピーカーの隣にないテーブルを知ってるくらいにはよく来るよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても戦略的だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 先月、友達の誕生日にここに連れてきたんだ。彼は6人を招待して、どこも予約してなかったの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはちゃんとしてるね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はそれを自発的だって言ったけど、私はオーナーに電話したの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、開けずにフルの仕事日を過ごしたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、君の「夜を救った」話は、実は誰かを知っているって話なんだね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私たち、食べたよね？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その後、彼が君のディナーを奢ってくれたらいいな。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん。私が企画してお金を払うなら、私の誕生日を祝ってもいいよね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら、そこにあるよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: え？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が自分を主役にする部分だよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次の話をしてもいいよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の英雄的なテーブル予約には勝てないと思うよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 挑戦してみて。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A useful contribution
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 役に立つ貢献だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった、昨日、教授が間違ったスライドを10分間説明してたの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 誰も何も言わなかったの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: みんなメモを取ってたよ。誰かがやっと聞くまでに、私は半ページ分書いてた。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼を遮るべきだったね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼が私よりも知識があると思ってたから、忙しかったの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 上司に対していつもその間違いをするの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最近はどんどん少なくなってる。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは君への褒め言葉じゃなかったよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はそうは受け取らなかったよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 感情的サポートの文学だね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes a change
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは変わったね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}}はマネージャーと一緒に飲みながら笑っている。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あの笑顔が、思っていた以上に痛い。昔は見るたびに、彼女が一緒にいたい相手は俺なんだと思えた。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Away From the Office
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: オフィスから離れて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 授業が終わったら何をするの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 目覚ましが嫌じゃなくなるまで寝てるよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その後は

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本を持って、時間に縛られないビーチでの一日が欲しいな。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大きなイベントじゃなくて、携帯を何度も確認しなくていいくらいの時間が欲しい。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: メインビーチから離れたいい場所を知ってるよ。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん、君は知ってるよね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's the place like?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その場所はどんな感じ？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 明日、教授がたくさんの罰の課題を出してくれるといいね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
Extra work with him is… fine
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼と一緒に仕事するのは…まあ、悪くないよ。
驚いてるの、かわいいね
何か気づいたんだけど
あなたって本当に手に負えないね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: とにかく、また質問攻めされる前に寝るね。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 私のパンツを買いに行ったのに、なぜかあなたの方が私よりもたくさん買っちゃったね。
私は単に効率がいいだけなの。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: あなたはショッピング業界の脅威だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: それでも私を招待してくれたんだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 9時過ぎ、バーの外で...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私みたいに聞こえるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 誰かがやらないとね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: わかった、すぐに取ってくるよ 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 午後はどうだった？食器棚は終わった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 終わらせて、気づいたら下の引き出しに手をつけてた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: そうやってハマっちゃうんだよね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: レストランを開けるくらいのテイクアウト用のカトラリーが見つかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いくつかは捨てたって言ってよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ほとんど捨てたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ほとんど？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 言ったことを後悔させないでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 急にフォークが必要になるかもしれないし

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: もし私のがなくなったら、そのことを考えておくね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 整理されてるのは実際いい感じだよね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: これで、何かが落ちてくることなくマグカップが見つけられるね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 驚くと思うよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それについて聞こうと思ってた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私のフォークのコレクション？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 今行くから、バカ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 今日出る前に明日の営業時間を確認したよ。5時に終わるから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 仕事の後に行ってもいい？6時頃に

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: もう遅いよ、それは私が取っておくから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、もちろん

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 他に行くところはないの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いいえ、あなたと一緒に夕方を過ごしたいな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私もそう思う

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 何か食べるものを作って、私たち二人を侮辱しない映画を選んでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 犯罪を解決しないで大丈夫？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 代わりにキッチンの食器棚を調査するよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: もっと危険な任務だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 防護具を持っていくね😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたがここにいるのが恋しかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 明らかに

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私も恋しかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それに、メッセージじゃなくて実際のハグが欲しいな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それは手配できるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いいね❤️ 明日仕事を出るときにメッセージするね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ここにいるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ちゃんといてよ、丸一日待って出かけてたら我慢できないからね😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ソファにスペースを作るね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いいクッションを取らないでね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 自分の家からまだ要求してるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いつも ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 君の停留所はここだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: じゃあ、明かりをつけたまま寝ちゃう前に寝るね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: お弁当箱は出した？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、シンクにあるよ。もう監視しなくていいよ😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 考えておくよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: おやすみイケメン、愛してるよ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私も愛してる、また明日ね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: また明日ね❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: どこにあるか知ってるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 音楽は良かった。明日やることがなければもっと長くいたかったな

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 次回のために覚えておこう

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: もう次のことを考えてるの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: またデートに連れて行くって言ってるのよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ちょっと不確実性を残しておいてもいいんじゃない？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 二人がバス停に向かって歩く中、会話は続く

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 二人で出ていく。夜が終わることを喜ぶべきなのに、もっと悪いことを待っている気がして離れない。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: なんで？自分が何を望んでるか分かってるから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それはいいね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたも急いでドアに向かってたわけじゃないでしょ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、そうじゃなかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 彼らは静かな角で止まり、バス停が通りの先に見える...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 今夜ずっとあなたにキスしたいと思ってたの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 本当に何も隠さないのね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それじゃないの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 調子に乗らないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: じゃあ、私の口を見ないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 外に出るまで、あそこがどれだけうるさいか気づかなかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 見てないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 彼氏がいるの。昨日から変わってないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 知ってるよ。仕事の話だけするために誘ったふりはしてないから

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、それははっきり言ってるよね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: たまには、そんなに得意げな顔をやめてくれない？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それを難しくしてるのはあなたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}}が彼のジャケットを引き寄せる

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: マネージャーが近づいて彼女にキスをし、彼女もキスを返す

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 今度は彼女が彼を引き寄せている。もう、彼が一方的にしただけだとは思えない。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: バスの前に

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 言わないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 何を？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 君はちゃんと声を聞かせてたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたが言おうとしてる得意げなことなんて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: いい夜だったって言おうと思ってたの

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: どういうわけか、それでも得意げに聞こえたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: そのうち慣れるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 運を天に任せないで

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 試す価値はあるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: もう行かなきゃ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたのバスはまだ来てないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 知ってるけど、バス停で待つつもりだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: わかった。明日ね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 君が私を寄りかからせて答えさせてたからだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 仕事で

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: そこにいるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: おやすみなさい

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night, {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: おやすみ、{{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 少し後、帰りのバスで...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: バスに乗ってるよ❤️ もうすぐ家に着くよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 座れた？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、やっと肩からバッグが外れたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: その本は楽になるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 思ってたよりずっとエキサイティングな一日だったよ 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 君は気にしてなさそうだったけど

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: バス停までの道のりは長かった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ううん、彼は角まで一緒に歩いてくれたけど、その後はバスを待ちに行ったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: わかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 中に入ったらメッセージするね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: わかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Once she is home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 彼女が家に着いたら...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: やっほー ❤️ 家に着いたよ、起きてた？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、まだここにいるよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 思ったより遅くなっちゃってごめんね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 楽しめた？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 君は私が何を気にするか決めるのが早いね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、楽しかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 料理も美味しかったし、バンドもフルセット演奏してくれたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: どんな音楽だったの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ほとんどカバー曲で、知ってるのもあったし、知ってるフリしたのもいくつかあったよ 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: そんなことするの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: すごく納得させる頷きが意外と通じるんだよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 次回、私が何か演奏する時に覚えておくね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それは全然違うよ、私はいつもあなたの複雑なゲームの決断を理解してるからね 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: そうだよね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: バーは良かったよ。前に行ったことなかったし

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: じゃあ教えて。楽しい夜だった？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたのマネージャーが選んだの？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、彼は夜の大半を私が彼の素晴らしいセンスを評価してるか確認するのに使ってたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 仕事外でも同じ感じなんだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 彼は自分の思い通りにするのが好きみたいだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたは？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 彼にジャケットを取ってくれって言われた時、'お願いします'を付けさせたよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 大きな成果だね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm choosing to count it 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それをカウントすることにするよ 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 楽しんでたみたいだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、少し外に出るのは良かったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: うん、楽しかったよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm glad you're home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: あなたが帰ってきて嬉しいよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 私も ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 着替えるからちょっと待ってて、もうこの服のままでいるのは嫌だし

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: わかった

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A few minutes later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 数分後...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ほら、靴も脱いだし、持ってるものもないよ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: それ、もっと楽そうだね

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: かなり楽だよ。バッグは朝まで待てるし

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: せめてお弁当箱は出しておいて

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There we go
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: よし、これで

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 未来の卒業生は今日どう感じてる？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: やっと卒業証書を手にするのが待ちきれない
彼が昨日メッセージくれたの
彼のプライベートジムで
彼が金持ちだってこと、忘れてた😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: いつもスポーツウェアだから忘れちゃうよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: まずは夏のボディが欲しいな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 昨日のコメント、結構響いたんだね？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: この夏ビキニが似合うようになりたいの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: だから今から始めないと

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: We have a session planned today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今日はセッションが予定されてる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: まだ卒業証書については完全に確信が持てないな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: なのに、君が彼を続けるように勧めたんだよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: でも、最後まで頑張り続けるつもりだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: イーサンと勉強することでこんなにやる気が出るなんて思わなかった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ゴールのニンジンがすごくモチベーションになるよね😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: もう隠そうともしてないじゃん
なんで隠す必要があるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: いつでも降りてきていいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: おはよう❤️ 片方のイヤリングをなくしちゃって、なぜかあなたのせいにしてるの。今朝はどう？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 起きたばかりの人にしては、なんだかスムーズすぎるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: しばらく起きてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 眠れなかったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早く起きちゃって、また快適に寝られなかったんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 特に大したことじゃないよ、ただ枕と喧嘩しただけ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: メッセージくれればよかったのに

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君は返事して、疲れてるって私を責めるんでしょ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはジュエリーのことで君を責めるのとは全然違うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もちろん

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 待って、見つけた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 朝ごはん前にその大胆な非難はすごいね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ずっと私の袖に引っかかってた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その謝罪を文書でお願いね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 親愛なるハンサム、証拠が私の非常に合理的な非難を支持しなかったことを残念に思うわ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 承認したよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素晴らしい、じゃあこれが一緒に合うかどうか決めるの手伝って

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 両方のイヤリング、両方の靴、バッグには実際の講義ノートが入ってる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 自分の人生をしっかり持っている女性のとても説得力のある印象だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、何度か試行錯誤したよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたのメッセージを読みながらつけてたの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、ちゃんと合ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: よかった、だってもう着替えたくないから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君は私の言うことなんて聞く気なかったよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君が間違ってたらね😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日はどう感じてる？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 準備を始める前に{{name:aiden}}にメッセージしたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それで笑って、片方を落としちゃって、今は片方だけとてもエレガントな耳になっちゃった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 授業の後に数分あるか聞いたの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼は何て言ったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、そして彼は借りたノートを持ってくるべきか聞いてきたの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 少なくとも、彼は覚えてるね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼はまだ私が何について話したいのか全然わかってない。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: だから、最初の一文を終わらせるために、全部テキストで説明したくなっちゃう。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それって本当に楽になるのかな？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 約10秒間ね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そしたら、彼が電話で笑ってるのかずっと考えて朝を過ごすことになる。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ちょっと awkward なことから始めてもいいんだよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: どんな感じか見せて

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: わかってるけど、いきなり魅力的になるところから始めたかったの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私にはうまくやったじゃん。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたは異常に寛容な観客だったね ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 最初の侮辱で私をつかまえたね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: じゃあ、彼がうざいって言うところから始めるべきかな。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼はこれが特別な会話だって気づいてないかも。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まさに私の心配。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 授業の後にちゃんと彼と話すつもり、また言い訳を作る前にね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: これについて嬉しそうに聞こえるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: プロフィールを公開したよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 6回目のイントロを書き直す前に。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨晩の写真、恋愛についての部分、そして私のとても魅力的なパスタ問題。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 強い導入

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本物のカフェでのコーヒーのことを言ったの、誰かが私の家に来るっていうのじゃなくてね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それ、あなたらしいね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その後、電話を裏返しに置いたの、指示を出してくるかもしれないから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 授業中に何も答えなくていいって知ってるでしょ？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだよ、休憩まで放っておくつもり。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 主に、最初の返信に今日の講義の文が入るのは嫌だから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 講義によるね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 研究方法のノートを導入として使うなんて、男にはふさわしくないわ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: すごく特定の興味を持った人が見つかるかもよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もうそういう人がいるんだから 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まあ、妥当だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今そこに実際にあるって、なんだか変な感じ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも、もう一日コンマを調整する代わりにボタンを押してよかった。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 問題がわかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何時に終わるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昼頃かな、誰かが出る直前に質問を見つけない限り。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それに、図書館が威圧的に丁寧なメールを送ってくる前に返さなきゃいけない本があるの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 敵に立ち向かう忙しい一日だね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなた、大学、図書館。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私、リストに載ってるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 着替えようとしてる時に、あなたが恋しくなっちゃった。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: どういたしまして

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは感謝の言葉じゃなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ちなみに、君のパスタを別の容器に入れておいたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: やっと

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: だから、すぐに来る理由ができたね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君はすでにいくつかとても実用的じゃない理由を持ってるよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それが私のお気に入りだよ ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: じゃあ、また君と話し始める前に行くね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は頑張ってね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、イケメン

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それと、コンソールの横にあるパッケージから出てこない朝ごはんを食べてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私の選択肢をかなり狭めちゃったね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それでも美しいから、私に対する訴えが弱くなるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: わざとやってるでしょ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: まだ彼に crush してるんでしょ？
ただ言ってるだけだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 準備できた、何かもっとひどいこと言う前に行こう

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: まだ服を選んでるところ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're not going to a party
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: パーティーに行くわけじゃないでしょ
トレーニングに行くんだから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: わかってる…でもやっぱり可愛く見せたいの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: でもその服じゃ、彼はずっとお尻ばっか見てるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: メインの試験の後も続けるなんて信じられない

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: すごく良い指導者がいるから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: というか…本当に良い罰とご褒美があるから😌
あなたは本当に手に負えないね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: でも、実際に勉強しないとね
わかってる、わかってる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: それやると集中するのが難しいんだよね…
身体接触を検知しました
勉強セッションの整合性が損なわれた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 今度は努力より先にご褒美が来たのか。この気持ちは冗談では片づけにくい。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAKが勉強セッション中の物理的報酬の証拠をアーカイブした
ありがとう…めっちゃ感謝してる 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 最高の成績が取れるように頑張るね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: イーサンが迎えに来るんだ
私はそうではありません

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why doesn't he just come to the house?
We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 彼の家の方がリラックスできるから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やっほー 😊 授業が終わったよ、図書館の本を返して、階段の日当たりのいい場所を確保したよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: こんなことを試すなら、信頼できる人とやりたいから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 二人とも？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。彼は君を信じてるし、私もそうだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君は何でも冗談にできるって知ってるけど、何か大事なことを伝えられるってことも知ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ああ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それがやっと君を黙らせた部分だったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一瞬ね、うん

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは本当に大事なことだよ。私もその部分は予想してなかったし

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そんなに驚かないでよ。たまには君のことをいいこと言うこともあるからね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その後すぐに私をバカって呼ぶことはあまりないけどね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今朝はどうだった？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはまだできるけどね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女が来たよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 感動してるよ。ほんとに。でも、友達が彼女をデートに連れて行くのを許してるって知るのはちょっと変な感じだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 感動して変だと思うのはありだよ。私は好奇心と恥ずかしさを同時に抱えてるけどね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 恥ずかしい部分に気づいたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろん、気づくよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君はここに来て私を誘うために歩いてきた後、5分間も私の目を避けてたよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを指摘しないでくれるといいなと思ってた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君は私の静かにしている能力を選んだわけじゃないよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明らかにそれは見落としだったね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちゃんと聞き始めたら大丈夫だったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、君はこれを望んでるの？彼がそのアイデアを気に入ってるからだけじゃなくて？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼を喜ばせるだけが目的なら、ここに来なかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたといるのが好き。私たちがこのフリをやめて、ただの冗談じゃないって感じたらどうなるのか、ちょっと気になるな。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気づいてたんだね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたが思ってるほど、全然巧妙じゃないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 魅力的になろうとしてたんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: たまにはうまくいくんだから。そんなこと言わせないでよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これをカジュアルに振る舞うのがすごく難しくなってるよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が最初の一言を言ってから、全然カジュアルじゃないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは公平だね。じゃあ、コーヒーに行こう。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気づくまでに日付を間違った場所に3回も書いちゃった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当にいいの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 驚いてるだけで、興味がないわけじゃないよ。違いがあるからね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった、だって一瞬、出口を探してるみたいに見えたから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 三回目に全部繰り返してって頼むより、もっと恥ずかしくないことを考えてたんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その努力に感謝するよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私はあなたが好き。ぎこちない会話があったからって、急にそれを認めるのが難しくなったわけじゃないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私たちの中には、ちょっと時間がかかった人もいるよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気づいてたよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 自分に満足し始める前に言っておくけど、私は初デートのことを聞いてるだけだからね。それ以上のことはまだ決まってないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。コーヒー飲んで、どう感じるか見てみよう。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気が散ってる学生？全然君らしくないね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 変な感じがしてもいいの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、変な感じになるね。でも、来週はコーヒーについて文句言って、あなたのフライドポテトを盗むから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 理想的には、私たちが出かけた理由をテーブル全体に話さずにね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろん。みんなに言ってるんじゃなくて、からかってるだけだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それとも、彼が私に正直だったことを後悔させるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってる。次に彼に会ったとき、ニヤニヤしないようにちょっと時間が必要かも。でも、彼を気まずくさせるつもりはないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当にそうしないの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は私を信頼してる。あなたもそう言ったばかりだし、私はそれをバカにするつもりはないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他のことについてだけ？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 奇跡を期待しない方がいいね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは無視することにするね😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ありがとう。本当に

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どういたしまして

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日コーヒーどう？キャンパス近くの椅子がバラバラなあの店があるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: カップが小さすぎるって文句言ったところ？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 小さすぎたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これ、もう私たちの普通の会話みたいだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少しずつ慣れてもらおうとしてるんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日でも大丈夫そうだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 時間は後で決める？最後の授業がいつ終わるか確認しないと

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, message me when you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、わかったらメッセージしてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I might be a little awkward at first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初はちょっと気まずくなるかも

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll give you something to complain about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、文句を言わせるようなことをしてあげるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You do that without trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを無意識にやってるよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See? We have a system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ほら、私たちにはシステムがあるんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日ね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日会いましょう

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 25分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 話したんだけど、明日コーヒーを飲みに行きたいって言ってたよ😊

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気分はどう？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 朝食からずっと肩を耳の近くに上げてたのに、今気づいたみたい

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can put them down now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう肩を下ろしていいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 頑張ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は私たちが彼について話したことを知ってるし、これを隠してるわけじゃないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: コーヒーだけの約束で、それ以上のことはないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did talking to him feel all right?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼と話すのは大丈夫だった？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 言った通り、終わるまで携帯をバッグに入れてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はあなたが知ってることを理解してるし、他のことについて約束せずにコーヒーを飲むことにしたんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話に集中できてよかったね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私も、頭の中がいっぱいいっぱいだったから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 言った通り、小さな詳細は自分の中に留めておくよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも大事な部分は大丈夫で、彼はあなたが知ってることを理解してるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日はコーヒーだけ、それ以上のことは決めてないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、会話の内容じゃなくて、どう感じてるか教えて

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ほっとして、自分にちょっと満足してる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰かの自信を借りてるみたいに感じると思ってた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、 awkwardな部分を言った後も、私はただの私だった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's the person he knows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが彼が知っている人だよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、それを思い出す必要があったと思う

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そして、彼に「はい」と言ってほしいと思った瞬間があった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはどうだった？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: アイデアについて話していた時よりも、もっと個人的だった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 悪くない、次の文を失うにはちょうどいいくらい

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}が中庭の門のところにいるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did the library forgive you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 図書館は君を許してくれた？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 言葉を失ったの？それについてあまり嬉しそうに見えないように頑張ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 絶対に違うよ、君は顔をしかめて、私は笑い始めただろうね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ほら、これが少し回復したバージョンだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very good smile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはとても素敵な笑顔だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I can't quite get rid of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってる、なかなか消えないんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 無理しなくていいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me do it again ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またやらせてるじゃん ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は後でスケジュールを教えてくれるから、その後に時間を決めよう

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight when you're settled
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 落ち着いたら今夜教えてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him I'd be there in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: すぐに行くって言ったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will, I need to go get something to eat first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、まず何か食べに行かなきゃ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've had a few messages on the app
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: アプリにいくつかメッセージが来てるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anything you feel like answering?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 答えたくなるようなことある？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One or two, yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一つか二つ、うん

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どこかで飲み物を持って座って、ドアの間で全部開けるんじゃなくて、ちゃんと読むつもりだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 図書館の出口に立っているよりは、たぶんこっちの方が楽だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それに、丁寧に追い出される可能性も低いしね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちゃんと話す機会があったら、メッセージするね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you still happy to talk to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ彼と話すの嬉しい？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかったよ ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 50 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 50分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 飲み物を飲み終わったら、話し続けたい人を見つけちゃった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds promising
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは期待できそうだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 実際に私が独身かどうか聞いてきたのはその男じゃなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: プロフィールの最初の文に戻して、その会話はそこで終わらせたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An efficient reading comprehension test
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 効率的な読解力テストだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very efficient
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: とても効率的だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the other conversation was nice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、もう一つの会話は良かったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は実際に私が書いたことを読んでくれたし、あなたについての部分もね
