story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、会話が始まる前にどう進むか決めようとするのをやめなきゃ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did that make it awkward?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それって気まずくなった？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はこれが私たちが合意したことか聞いてきたから、はいって言ったら、秘密にしようとはしなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それから普通の会話ができたのが、私が望んでいた部分だったんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: なんで彼に返事したの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼の写真の一つは、すごく焦げたピザで、その下に謝罪が書いてあったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: つまり、彼の料理で選んだの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼を選んだのは、笑えたからで、いいスタートだと思ったんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼の最初のメッセージは、私が料理する想像上の人たちが皿洗いを手伝ったことがあるかどうかだったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 独身かどうか聞くよりはマシだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一文ずつね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: かなりの改善だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼に彼らがひどいゲストだって言ったら、彼は唯一のディナーゲストが冗談で消火器を持ってきたことがあるって言ってたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ピザのせい？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どうやら、写真のピザの前にいくつかの試みがあったみたい

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その執念が称賛に値するかどうか決められないな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼に料理させる必要はないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを言ったら、彼はすぐにちゃんとしたスタッフがいる場所を提案してきたよ 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼らしい考えだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は26歳で、街の反対側で働いてて、私たちの大学のサークルにはいないんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ彼のことはよく知らないけど、毎回私を感心させようとせずに話せるところが好きだったな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはちょっと理にかなっててイラッとするね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼と話すのは楽しい？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今のところはそうだね、あまり頑張らずに笑わせてくれたし

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いくつかの小さな詳細は自分の中に留めておくけど、これは新しい人で、私たちの友達の誰でもないんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、今はそれで十分だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が私がどこに消えたのか聞かずに、数分かけて答えられたのも良かったな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: スマホを宿題みたいに感じさせないのはいいスタートだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 正確に

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今携帯をしまうね、さもないと君と話し続けちゃうから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私たちが止まる頃には、明日コーヒーを飲みに行く話をしてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もうどこか決めたの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: メインのショッピングストリート近くの大きな窓があるカフェを提案したよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 知ってる場所で、午後に、ただ一杯飲んで、実際にうまくやれるか確かめようよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それ、やりたいことに感じる？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: はい

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 実は、彼が聞く前にその提案を打ってる自分に気づいたの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: メッセージをもらうよりも、それに驚いたわ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それについて嬉しそうだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私は

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 行ってらっしゃい。後でここにいるからね❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰かとただの形式的なやり取りをするために探してたわけじゃないの。楽しんだ会話があって、もう一度したかっただけ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それ、もっと君らしいね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私もそう感じたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 同時に君に情報を伝えようとしなくて済んだのも助かった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は二つの会話を行き来するんじゃなくて、君とちゃんと話せる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが、どちらからも半分の文をもらうより好きだな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ありがとう

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: とにかく、これは普通のメッセージを二十回も書き直さずに送った後の彼女だよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 自分に満足してるみたいだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうなの、今はその気分を五分だけ楽しむことにしてる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 五分以上楽しんでもいいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 危険だね、私が耐えられない存在になっちゃうかも

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そのリスクを取るよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちなみに、この写真は君のためだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: この小さな勝利を祝ってる私の姿を他の誰にも見せないからね😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その特別な瞬間、大切にするよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 数分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日のグループミーティングが午前のままかどうかわかったら、後で時間を確認するね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今夜教えてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、するよ ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 大学に関係ない会話も楽しむ彼氏がいることを忘れないでね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一瞬も忘れてないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でも、行く前に今日の普通のことを一つ教えて

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一つのことをするためにゲームを開いたら、コントロールを変更するのに30分もかかっちゃった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは痛いほど信じられるわ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 別の出口から逃げたんじゃないかと思い始めてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 受付の女性は私を見向きもしなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 結局、前の設定の方が好きだから戻しちゃった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ありがとう、それでずっと生産的な気分になったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 手伝えて嬉しいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 後でメッセージしてね、実際にプレイするかどうか知りたいから❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少しでそうなりそうだったけど、私は信頼できるって評判があるからね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いつから？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 素晴らしい第一印象を与えてるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 第一印象？もうそれは過ぎたと思ってたけど

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: さあ、少し歩こうよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 2人が中庭に入ってくる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話が続く

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何も感じないふりをしなくても、彼女に選ぶ余地をあげられる。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 人混みから離れて

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: さて、今君は本当に気になることを言ってるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日言ったこと覚えてる？静かなところで話したいって言ったやつ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、12回も聞かないで大人になってたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ただビープ音を出した機械に謝罪の準備をしたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その努力に感謝するよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここはいい場所かな？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、ちょっと座ろう

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: バッグのストラップをいじってるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何のこと？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 指でぐるぐる回してるやつ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気づかなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これが何であれ、完璧に聞こえなくてもいいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは君からの危険なほどの優しさだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何を話してるのか分かるまでジョークは取っておくよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: とても感動的なやり取りだったね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}}と、私が他の人とデートすることについて話してたの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっと待って、何それ？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少し静かにしてくれる？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ごめん、でも…{{name:player}}は君に他の男とデートしてほしいってこと？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。しばらくその話をしてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: なんで？二人の間に何かあったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いいえ、私たちは一緒に幸せだよ。別れたり、誰かを代わりに見つけることじゃないの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、何か見落としてるね。彼女が他の誰かと付き合いたい理由が気になるから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼がその話を持ち出したの。彼は私が他の誰かと一緒にいるアイデアが好きで、一緒に決めたいんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私たち二人とも成長したと思うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼がその話を持ち出したの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。それについて話した後、私も好奇心が湧いてきたの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本気なの？これは君たちが私の反応を見ようとしてるわけじゃないよね？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がこれを説明して楽しんでるように見える？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ごめん。君を笑ってるわけじゃないの、ただ本当にそれには準備ができてなかったの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が最初に教えてくれたとき、私もそうだった。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかったけど、なんで私に教えてるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君がその人になることについてどう思うか聞きたかったから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私？待って、私とデートしたいってこと？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 違う、君の後ろにいる男のこと。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: とにかく、ここで5分間隠れてるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そんなことしないで、まだ追いつこうとしてるんだから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そう、君のこと。だから君に会うように頼んだの。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: マジで？彼は私だって知ってるの？ただの知らない男じゃなくて？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私たちは君のことを具体的に話したから、これは彼の背後で話してるわけじゃないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: つまり、彼は君が今ここにいて、私にこれを聞いてることを知ってるの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。彼は私が授業の後に君と話すつもりだって知ってた。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君が何かについてアドバイスを求めてると思ってた。私がその一部になるとは思ってなかった。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だから、私が朝ずっとどう言うか考えてた理由がわかったでしょ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が私に君とフラートするのをやめろって言うと思ってた。これは全然違う会話だね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: せめてもう少し自慢しないふりをしてくれたらいいのに。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ自慢する段階じゃないよ。君を信じようとしてるところなんだから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}}も、意外な一面を隠してたんだな？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうなんだ。最初にそれについて話したとき、私も全く同じ顔をしてたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: かわいそうなやつだね。やっと本音を言ったのに、今は私たちが反応を比べてる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が銀行強盗を手伝ってくれって言ったみたいに、じっと見つめてるのはあなただよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 銀行のことならもっと早く理解できたかも

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは驚かないな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に、あなたたちからこんな提案を聞くとは思わなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。私たちは一緒に新しいことを発見するのが好きだけど、これはちょっと話が必要だったね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうであってほしいな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君は静けさを楽しんでるみたいだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初はどう思ってたか分からなかったけど、もっと話していくうちに、どんな感じになるのか見てみたいと思った

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それで私が登場するってわけ？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 結局ね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは誰のアイデアだったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたのことを話してたんだよ。全部の会話は聞いてないでしょ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたに感謝すべきか、彼に感謝すべきか聞いてるだけだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたが私の質問にちゃんと答えるまで、どちらにも感謝しないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今、私が苦しむのを楽しんでるでしょ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少しね。今朝からずっと緊張してたんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった。なんで私なの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今回は誰も次のスライドが重要かどうか聞けないね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女があんな風に現れるとは思わなかった 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女はずっと君に crush してたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 今はそれをフル活用してるだけだね 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: マジでエクササイズに集中するのが難しかった 😭
みんな大人なんだから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 誰でも好きなことができるよ
君は本当にクレイジーだね 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 次のセッションが楽しみ 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 君は足を大事にしてね
今日は結構頑張ったね 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 医者にギプスを外してもらったのは、まだ二日前だぞ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: ギプスなしの初めてのセッションで、ほとんどのエクササイズをこなしたね
{{name:hailey}}も自分の役割を果たしたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: セッション中、集中するのが本当に大変だった 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ 夕食をテーブルに出したよ、もう食べた？それともまだゲームと交渉中？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: こんな風に君と話すのが好きだよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 冗談で答えられない質問をしても？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 特にそういう時ね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すぐにもう一度挑戦すると思うけどね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: チャンスを待ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 予想通りの男ね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とにかく、動けなくなる前に何か試したいの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日のために？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、最初に引っ張り出したものを着るつもりだったの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、好きなものを選びたいって気づいたの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 見せて

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと待ってね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これ、寒かったらジャケットも合わせるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね、気に入ったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すごく早く返事したね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もっとゆっくり褒めてほしい？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 信じられる褒め言葉がいいな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 服のことを心配するんじゃなくて、午後を楽しむ準備ができてるみたいだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それ、美味しそうだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがまさに私が求めていたことなの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、君は美しいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その部分も助かるよね 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この靴なら一歩一歩考えずに歩けるから、これで行くよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても実用的なファッションの選択だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私は多面的な存在なの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、その服は私がキープするね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食と私、どっちがいいの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もし彼に写真を送ることにしたら、あなたにもそれを送るからね、約束した通り

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これはあなたのためだけに撮ったの、他には送ってないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 先に見せてもらえるのが好きなの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、感謝してね、ジャケットを着るのにすごく格好悪い奮闘があったから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その部分を見逃したのは残念だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食のことを聞いたのはあなたでしょ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちなみに、これは私たちだけの秘密だよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日をあなたが見なきゃいけないもののコレクションにはしないからね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そのドレスを見逃したら、やっぱり残念だったと思うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの普通の彼女の写真はなくならないからね 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この写真はあなたのためだけ、彼に送ったものの報告じゃないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ドレスを楽しんで、明日は私のちょっとした秘密も持たせてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは受け入れられるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかった、だって私は全ての文を事前に考えないのが楽しいから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分から行動してもいいんだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: この写真はあなたのためだけ、彼には送ってないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日は私たちが話している間、携帯を放置しておいて、その後に教えることができるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは私にとっても正しいと思うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も、初めてのコーヒーを画面を見ながら過ごしたくないから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これを試着している間に、他のことが起こったの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食は美味しそうだし、あなたの向かいに座っていたいな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼がこれを気に入るかなって考えちゃったの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして、それを見たときにすぐにあなたの顔を見たくなった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 両方とも欲しかったっていうのが好き

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も、実は

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その気持ちが邪魔になるかと思った

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その代わり、私はここに立ってドレスを見せたかっただけ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 見せてくれて嬉しいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがいいね❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、私たちの映画の午後はまだ続いてるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: パスタの容器を冷蔵庫の前に置いておいたから、来るときに忘れないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがなくても入れてあげるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってるけど、私がどれだけ気前の良い訪問者か理解してもらうのが大事なんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物には気前がいいけど、リモコンには容赦ないよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が選んでいいって言ったじゃん

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 覚えてるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね、実際に俳優が見えるものを見つけたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを手放すつもりはないよね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そのドアのところに立っていた人が誰か分かるまでね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、食べてる時に笑わせるのはやめてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 誰も知らない、それが映画の一部なんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ひどいシステムだね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 待って、明日の服のまま寝ちゃう前に着替えてくるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8分後

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ずっと良くなったよ、誰にも見せないためにこの服を着てるんだから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私にも見せてくれないの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっとだけ特別に見せてあげるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もこのバージョン好きだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 良かった、だってこれが私たちの映画の時に着る服だから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その部分は約束できないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の隣に座れるならそれでいいよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがポイントなんだよね❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君を起こしておく理由を見つける前に、電話を置くね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ、美しい女の子

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ、ハンサム

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日聞く前に朝ごはんを食べておくね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女が来たよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はずっとここにいたよ😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今日は足の調子はどう？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べたよ、実際に少しプレイした

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと疲れたけど、無理はしなかったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 外に出るのは好きだったよ、冒険じゃなくてもね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 良いことは冒険じゃなくてもいいんだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが理性的になるなんて、珍しいね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今日はたくさんの勇気を使ったから、残りは大事にするね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そういえば、明日の予定は決まったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: コントロールは前と全く同じところに？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}が早く終わるから、キャンパス近くのカフェで3時半に会うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 椅子が合ってないカフェだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼がメッセージを送ってきた時、違う感じがした？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと慎重になったかもね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: awkwardじゃなくて、ただすべてをジョークにしようとする意欲が少し減っただけだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼を驚かせたかもしれないね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分でも驚いたよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 物を片付けているときに、実際に彼に何を聞いたか思い出したんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから、ただ廊下に立って何もないところに微笑んでた

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを見たかったな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それをまた持ち出す必要はないよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いや、君が何を笑ってたのか聞いて、もっと悪化させただろうね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほぼ確実にね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 変なのは、彼のことをもう知ってるってことだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日は、知ってる人を見ながら、彼がまだ聞いたことのないことを言うかどうか考えてるだろうな

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが君が気になってる部分なの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、そうだと思う

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼を別の人に変えようとしてるわけじゃないよ。ただ、普通のランチじゃないってことをやめたときに、これがどう感じるのかを見たいだけなんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 午後3時半にメインショッピングストリートの近くのカフェで会うよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少しは必要だよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 場所を知ってるから選んだの。最初の10分間迷うことはないしね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いい選択だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、まだ会ったことのない人からの送迎はなしで、一人で行くよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晩はたくさん話してた？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食の前に少しだけ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから、食事中だから電話を置くって言ったんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はそれをどう受け止めたの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 普通の人みたいに、やることもあるしね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 小さなことに聞こえるけど、自分を説明しなくていいのが好きだった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 実際に会ったらうまくやっていけると思う？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何を作ったの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう願ってるけど、メッセージだけで彼の性格を作り上げるんじゃなくて、会いたいの

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼が最初は静かか、手を使って話すか、自分のジョークで笑うかはわからない

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最後のはもう誰かいるじゃん

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう、彼はそれが素晴らしいジョークだって言い続けてる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら？完全に理不尽だよね 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ知らないことがあるのが好き

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼を一気に私の生活に招待するほどではないけど、コーヒーが飲みたいくらい

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: オムレツとサラダだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、あなたの番だよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何のための私の番？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が明日彼に会うって言ったとき、最初に思ったことは何？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すごくサポートしてくれる答えじゃなくて、最初のやつね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 正直？読み終わる前に笑顔になったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これが欲しいけど、急にもっと現実的に感じる

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなに早く？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、特にあなたが教えてくれたとき、嬉しそうだったから

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから、どれだけ笑顔だったかよりも、もっと明白じゃないことを言おうと考えたんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを言えばよかったのに。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: パスタはどうしたの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の午後を僕の反応に変えたくなかったんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それでも君の反応を聞きたいな。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の役割がただ僕が大丈夫かどうかを聞くだけになってほしくないんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、うん、楽しみだし、君が彼に聞きたかったのは嬉しいよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はやったよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、君がスマホを見ながら笑っているのを知るのも好きだよ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 悪い意味でリアルなの？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 悪くはないよ、ただ、想像上の午後について話すのとは違うだけ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: パスタとお互いに恨み合う前に休憩してるんだ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今は実際の時間があって、明日君は準備して出かけるんだね。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: カレンダーに入れたとき、僕も同じ瞬間を感じたよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君には行ってほしいけど、こんなに違いに気づくとは思わなかったんだ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 完全にリラックスしているふりをするんじゃなくて、教えてくれてありがとう。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君にそれをやめさせようとは言ってないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知ってるよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日はそれについて完璧な話をしようとは思ってないよ。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね、だって君の実際の午後の話を聞きたいから。

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、それが君に届くよ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 待って、私が違う料理を作れる証拠を見せるね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: スポーツに戻るのは本当に気持ちよかった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 実際には{{name:aiden}}とのフリートークが気持ちよかったんじゃない？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 何のことか全然わからないよ 😇
もちろんわからないよね
君は本当に好奇心旺盛だね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 二人が楽しんでるのが嬉しいよ
自分にそう言い聞かせてね

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: もっと楽しむ準備をしてね 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 本当にいいセッションだった

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 実際に成功しそうな気がする

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: エイサンを君のベッドに入れることね、うん
試験のことを言ってるんだよ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: なのに、君は私にメッセージを送り続ける

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: おはようございます

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: もしあるなら、妙に静かだね
インターネットあるよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: じゃあ、なんでまだ私を褒めてくれないの？
無視されてる気分だよ
これは心の傷だよ
あなたって本当に甘えん坊だね
あなたは本当に素敵に見えます
甘えん坊じゃないよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: ただ、褒め言葉が遅れてるのに気づくのが得意なだけ
それとも、こんにちは？
ついに
そんなに難しかった？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: とにかく、退屈すぎる！
やることがないよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 大学の準備はしないの？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: だって、もう年はほぼ終わりだし
試験も終わったし
もうわからなくなっちゃった

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I don’t technically need to show up anymore

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 休憩するのは当然だよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜はありがとう。役に立った部分とソファの部分もね ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: どちらも楽しんだよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も。特にノートパソコンを閉じた後の部分がね

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今、また全部リハーサルする前に寝る準備をしてるところ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 了解。君の番だよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: おやすみ、愛してる

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: おやすみ ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}がスライドを開いてプレゼンテーションを始める。君は彼女が質、便利さ、そして個別のサービスがどのように顧客を戻らせるかを説明するのを聞く。途中で彼女は一時停止し、ノートを見下ろす。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ここでいつも詰まっちゃうの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I ask something?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 何か聞いてもいい？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。君がここにいる理由だよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もし二つの場所が同じものを同じ値段で売っていたら、どうして誰かが一方を選ぶの？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 体験だよ。そこが買い物しやすいか、スタッフが助けてくれるかどうか...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それは納得できるね。その部分を質問から始めたらどう？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あの長い定義の代わりに？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。まず例を教えて、それから説明して。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 出かけてるよ。食べ物を取ってからすぐにそっちに行くね❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 待って。ちょっとメモさせて。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女は質問をノートに追加して、近所のカフェ二軒を例にしてそのセクションをもう一度試す。今回は止まらずに進めた。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 全部わかったよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 簡単すぎた？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いいえ。君の言いたいことはわかったよ。それで定義ももっと理解できた。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。それは実際に役立ったよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't ruin your good work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: せっかくの頑張りを台無しにしないで。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20分後 — {{name:lena}} はプレゼンテーションを終え、時間を確認してノートパソコンを閉じる。君は彼女の結論について最後の質問をし、彼女はノートを見ずに答える。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ずっと良くなった気がする。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was work?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 仕事はどうだった？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 二回目はもっと目を合わせてたね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君は僕がするたびに、ちゃんと見てくれてたよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君はちゃんと聞いてくれる観客を求めてた。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうだね。そういうのがあるのは好きだったよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 真剣に取り組んでくれてありがとう。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}が君の椅子の横に移動して、君にキスをするためにかがむ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: リハーサルの後

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ノートパソコンを閉じるのを待ってたんでしょ？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ルールを守ってたんだ。君が終わるまでキスはなし。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: すごく規律正しいね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: プレゼンテーションのことを心配する暇がないくらい忙しかったよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今はただの観客のふりをやめてもいい？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ぜひそうして。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君が来る理由にプレゼンテーションは必要なかったよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: わかってる。でも、練習は必要だったんだ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そして君と一緒に夕方を過ごしたかった。うまくいったね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん、そうだね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25分後 — 食事の後、君はソファに移動する。{{name:lena}} は君のそばに寄り添い、回復中の足のためにスペースを空ける。君の腕が彼女の肩に回り、彼女は君に向かってもう一度キスを求める。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: テーブルよりずっと良いね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The table wasn't that bad.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: テーブルもそんなに悪くなかったよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I couldn't sit like this there.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あそこではこんな風に座れなかったから。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: サンドイッチを持ってきたよ。ちょっとしたら会おうね

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、こっちに来て。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Sandwiches
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: サンドイッチの後

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your hand is wandering.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君の手がさまよってるよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can tell me to stop.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 止めてって言ってもいいよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 止めてなんて言ってないよ。もっと上。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女が置いた場所に手を

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the other one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もう一つは？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それもいいよ。下に。もう決めたから。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜を礼儀正しく保つのがすごく難しくなってるよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: プレゼンテーションは終わったよ。丁寧にする必要はないから。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: すぐ会おうね

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My turn too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私の番もね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't have to.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そんなことしなくてもいいよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: わかってる。したいの。ジーンズを開けて。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女の手

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もしそれが多すぎたら教えてね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そんなことないよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: On the Sofa
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ソファの上で

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. That was the point.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そこだよ。それがポイントだったの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 自分に満足してるみたいだね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうだよ。後で感謝してね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 少し後 — {{name:lena}}がノートと食べ物のバッグを持って君のところに到着する。君は彼女にキスで挨拶し、サンドイッチをキッチンに置いて一緒にテーブルに座る。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25分後 — 片付けた後、彼女は君に寄り添う。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 快適？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. Are you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。あなたは？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: とても。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then stop moving away to talk.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、話すために離れないで。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたの一日について聞こうと思ってたの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 大学はどうだった？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: まあまあ。だけど、ちゃんと食べる代わりに、そのイントロを書き直してたの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、そのサンドイッチは重要だったんだね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: とても重要だったよ。気が散る前にプレゼンテーションを手伝ってくれてありがとう。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: わかった。10分間、君が私の彼氏じゃないふりをしてほしいの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ここに来る前に、あなたがほとんどの作業をしてくれたよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: あなたが声に出して言うのを手伝ってくれた。それが私に必要だった部分なの。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20分後 — その後、{{name:lena}} は時間を確認し、ノートをまとめる。彼女はノートパソコンを片付け、両方のバッグを持って君のところに来る。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 両方のバッグは大丈夫？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。私を戻すための管理的な理由は全く残さないよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 一つなくても大丈夫だと思う。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうなるといいなと思ってた。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}はバッグを一瞬置いて、あなたの方に戻る。彼女はあなたにさよならのキスをして、片方の手をあなたの肩に置き、あなたの腕は彼女の腰に回る。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 出発前にもう一つ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: わかった。じゃあ、本当に行くね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それは難しい最初のリクエストだね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 家に着いたらメッセージしてね。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん。愛してる。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Love you too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も愛してる。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}は両方のバッグを持って出て行く。あなたはテーブルを片付けて、残りの夜を過ごす。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20分後 — {{name:lena}} は家にいる。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 家に着いたよ❤️ 両方のバッグも無事だよ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 素晴らしい。忘れたノートはない？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I checked twice
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ないよ。二回確認したから。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それに、荷物を解くときにその難しい部分をもう一度試してみたよ。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: どうだった？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、観客の普通の人ってことね。私が終わるまでキスはダメだよ。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今朝はセッションがあるんだ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: いつもより早くなった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 彼のスケジュールに合うからって
詳しくは聞かなかった
あまり押し進めたくなかったし
あまり寝れなかった。君は？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今回は急がなくていいよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I made some breakfast for you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 君のために朝ごはんも作ったよ
わかってる、わかってる 🫥

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I kept waking up for no reason
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 理由もなく何度も目が覚めちゃった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: それで、バカみたいに天井を見つめてた

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 脳が考えすぎる朝なんだ
