story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ 今夜のために何か買ってきてほしいものある？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何度も目が覚めたけど、動き出せば大丈夫だよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君はどうだった？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まあまあだよ、今朝は郵便受けまで行って戻ってきたし

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 誰かに頼まなくて済むのは気持ちいいよね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだね、たとえ集めたのが迷惑メールだけでも

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その努力にしては残念な賞品だね😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: なんとかなるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's on the menu tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今夜のメニューは何？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 鶏肉とご飯、説明書がいらないものだよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それなら私に任せて

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君だけでいいよ、あとは私がやるから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君の好きなレモネードも買ってきたよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 覚えててくれた？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ここにいるときはいつも探してるからね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは本当に優しいね❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: デザートは私が持ってくるから、その部分は任せて

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: デザートには逆らわないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素晴らしい、争わずに一つ決まったね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まだ6時頃？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、5時に終わるよ。途中で寄ってそのまま行くね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ここにいるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 全部やらなくてもよかったのに

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今夜これをするのが嬉しいな

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私も

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 遅れる前に準備を終わらせないと

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まだ準備できてないの？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう少し、片方のイヤリングをつけたまま君と話してた😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 数分後、彼女が出発する前に...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: はい、両方のイヤリングもつけてるよ😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素敵に見えるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ディナーだよ、結婚式じゃないんだから😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 良い一日を！

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君もね、私が着く前に美味しい部分を全部食べちゃダメだよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: カリカリの部分については約束できないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 少し残しておいてよ、さもないとデザートは私のものだからね😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大好きだよ、今夜会おうね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私も愛してるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to help
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: わかってる、ただ手伝いたかっただけ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can help me eat it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 食べるの手伝ってくれてもいいよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I'm very qualified for 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その部分は私得意だからね😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning, by the way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ところで、おはよう

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: おはようイケメン❤️ すぐに計画モードに入ったよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: よく眠れた？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ねえ😊 戻る前に大事な質問！アップルタルトとチョコレート、どっちがいい？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、終わるまで待ってるね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 出るときにメッセージするね❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5時前に、マネージャーのオフィスで...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} の近くでオフィスの会話が検出されました

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今夜{{name:lena}}に会えるのを楽しみにしているはずなのに、あの職場からの知らせが届くたび、昨夜に引き戻される。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 終わった？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 更新された合計はあなたの受信箱に入ってるよ、署名済みのコピーはこのフォルダーにある

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 持ってきて、噛まないから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 指示なしでデスクにフォルダーを置くこともできるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女がいる。今日はほとんど私に話してくれなかったね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨夜の終わり方について考えてた

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: アップルタルト

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私もそう思ってた

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そんな風じゃないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しんでなかったって言うつもり？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しんだよ。それが問題じゃない

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 帰ってから、何もなかったかのように彼と話した

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: キスだっただけで、プロポーズじゃないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はそうは思わないだろうね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はいなかったし

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが良くなるわけじゃないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: バーの外ではこんなに心配してなかったじゃん

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった、そう言ってくれると思ってた

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もっと心配すべきだった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それに、私もキスを返したのがさらに悪いことだった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、楽しんだことを否定するのはやめて

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうじゃないよ。ただ、私がしたことや彼に隠していることが悪い気がするだけ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼がどう思うかなんて気にしないで。私にキスしたし、楽しんだんでしょ。それが全てだよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼を傷つけたくないの

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 傷つけないよ。彼と一緒にいても、私と楽しい時間を過ごせるから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それができるかどうかわからない

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: できるよ。やりたいと思えばいいだけ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 終わったら一緒に飲みに行こうよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これが本当に選択肢だったの？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いいえ、今夜彼と会うの

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ディナー？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ディナーと映画。6時頃に行くって言ったの

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: すごく家庭的だね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がやりたいことなんだから、退屈に聞こえなくてもいいのに

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 別の日に会ってもいいよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私のために決めないようにしてみてよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しい時間を過ごせるってわかってるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 自分の声を聞くのに飽きないよね？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が正しいときはね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私に同意してもよかったのに😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今出発するね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がどこにいるかわかってるでしょ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここで働いてるから、見つけるのは難しくないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}}はバッグを持ち上げてオフィスのドアに向かう

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女のマネージャーは彼女が出て行くときにお尻を見ている

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女が出ていく。ようやく止めていた息を吐けた。それでも、彼が去る彼女を見る目は嫌だ。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 時間通りに出発

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5時、オフィスの外で...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5時、出るよ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全部終わった？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日はこれで十分、残りは元の場所に置いてきたよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事中？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 午後はどう？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰か他の人を1時間困らせる場所にね😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: タルトを買ってからそっちに行くね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 急がなくていいよ、まだ料理はできてないから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: パン屋にちょっと寄った後...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 残り2切れあったよ。それは素晴らしい計画だと思う

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 運が良かったね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私のとても整理整頓された彼女のイメージを壊さないでね😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 箱を立てたままにしておいて、これだけお願いね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: バスの座席は私よりもいい位置にいるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最後の書類作業がほぼ終わるところ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 6時頃に会おうね❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5時には出るよ、フォルダーに私たちの夜を奪わせないから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ料理始めてないから、時間はあるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってる、今回は時間通りに出たいだけなんだ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 何してるの？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 試験が終わったら何をするつもり？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: まだそこまで考えてないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: でも最初は、体が起き上がるまで寝ると思う
それから休暇を楽しむよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: それはいい変化だね
わかるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ストレスで時間が過ぎて、自由な時間がどう感じるか忘れそうだった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 終わったらすぐに思い出すよ
そうだといいな

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: しばらく無駄に過ごすのが楽しみだな
関係ないでしょ
もう無駄にしてるんじゃない？
ふざけんな
とにかく

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}}が実際にいい匂いの料理を作ったよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼女が私にあの目を向ける前に食べに来て！
今行くよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼女が私にあの目を向ける前に食べに来て！
今行くよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}}と一緒に夕食を取るところだよ。参加する？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:lena}}ともう食べたよ。彼女は帰ったから、挨拶しに行くね。
あまり時間かけないでね
失礼だね
ごめんね、小さな赤ちゃん

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 今夜はいい気分だね
何が欲しいの？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just wanted to annoy you a little
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ちょっと邪魔したかっただけ
おめでとう！
ミッション成功だね
そうだね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ 下にいるよ、君のデザートはバスに耐えたよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女の電話はバッグに戻る。あなたが毛布を彼女の足にかけると、彼女は画面ではなくあなたの方を向く。「何？」とあなたが尋ねる。「何でもない。こっちに来て。」彼女はあなたに頭を寄せ、毛布の下であなたの手を握る。映画が始まっていることに気づくまで、あなたが軽く押すまで待つ。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80分後 — 君たちは映画を近くで見て、時々主演俳優が面白いかどうかで口論する。エンドロールが流れると、彼女はもう数分残ってから自分のものを取りに行く。ドアのところで、彼女は君を長く抱きしめ、家に着いたらメッセージを送ると約束し、バスに向かう。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分後 — {{name:lena}} は家にいる。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 帰ったよ❤️ 今夜はありがとう

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 無事に帰れた？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、座れたし、降りる前にほとんど寝そうになった😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ソファに髪のゴムを置いてきたよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは取っておいて、またそのクッションを盗む口実が必要だから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 口実なんていらないよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私は知ってる ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜、何度か静かになってたね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ごめん、色々考えてたんだ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何かした？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいえ、あなたは何も悪くないよ、完璧だから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたと一緒にいられて本当に嬉しかった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 来てくれて嬉しかったよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も、画面の向こうから見るんじゃなくて、あなたの隣にいるのが恋しかった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 毛布を盗むのがずっと簡単だね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それもね😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 見た目はあまり良くないけど、まだ食べられるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、あなたの映画も好きだったよ、あの男が面白いはずだとはまだ思わないけど

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの方が私よりも笑ってたよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 主にあなたが彼を笑ってるのを見てたから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを受け入れるよ

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食も本当に美味しかったよ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の鶏肉が全部あなたの皿にない状態でも？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 始めないで、私は一切れだけ取ったんだから😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し寝なよ、あなたは私の上で寝そうだったから

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほとんど寝ちゃった。しばらくどこにも行かなくて良かったのが嬉しかった

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: またやろうね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 利用可能だよ😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それ、いいね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみイケメン、愛してるよ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も愛してる、よく眠ってね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 悪化する前にドアを開けるね

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: お願い、そうして

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6時頃、君がドアを開けると、{{name:lena}}はペストリーの袋を置いて、挨拶を終える前に君を抱きしめる。彼女は君の頬にキスをして、もう少し君に寄り添った後、部屋に入る。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分後 — 夕食の時、君は彼女のために買ったレモネードを注ぐ。彼女はボトルを見て、次に君を見る。「冷蔵庫に入れてくれたのね」と彼女は言う。「温かいレモネードは悪い評価を受けるかと思った。」彼女は微笑むが、君の手を取る前に一瞬黙る。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食の間に会話が和らいでいく。彼女は朝のことを話しながら、あなたの皿から鶏肉の一切れを盗む。あなたが気づくと、彼女はあなたの方が約束されたカリカリの端があると言い張る。タルトの二切れを出すと、どちらが大きいか決めようとするあなたを見て笑う。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分後 — 君の皿を片付けるのを手伝った後、彼女はソファの横に靴を置き、いいクッションを取る。彼女は君のそばに座るときに髪の結び目を外す。映画が始まる前に、彼女は君の肩に寄りかかり、二人の写真を撮る。彼女はそのコピーを君に送る。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:ethan}}と一緒に復習本を買いに行かなきゃ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: それは彼の家に行くってことだよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: いや、ほんとに本が必要なんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 年末になって急に頑張り始めるのが面白いね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: やる気を引き出す教授がいるとこうなるんだよ 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 多分、ベッドでゴロゴロしてるかな
これの代償は払ってもらうからね
全力で爆発モードに入るから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}}も君と遊びたくなくなるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}}を呼んで遊ぶことにしたよ
もっと早く教えてくれればよかったのに
君が苦しむのを見るのが好きなんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 全身痛くて、髪もぐちゃぐちゃで、半分死んでるみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: やっほー😊 アラームの前に起きちゃったから、今3時半が1週間先に感じるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私は、あなたが自分の気持ちを一番重要でない部分のように扱うのをやめてほしいだけなの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 頑張ってるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私を作り上げなきゃいけない自分のバージョンじゃなくて、私としてこれをやってほしいって言ってくれるのが好き

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それが、私が愛している女の子だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはずるいくらい甘かったよ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今、あなたがキッチンテーブルで私を笑顔にさせる前に探してたものを忘れちゃった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 鍵？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、実はそう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私を見て、役に立って魅力的でしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 台無しにしないようにしよう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 後で準備ができたらメッセージするね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 良い朝を。会議がランチの時間を飲み込む前に食べてね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は本当に私の仕事を奪ってるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは私が作ったものよりずっと良さそうだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: シンクの上で食べるんじゃなくて、皿に何か乗せてみたら？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君はここにいなかった。何も証明できないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたを知っています

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今朝はグループミーティングがあるから、その後家に帰って着替えるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨日のドレスまだ着てるの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。あの決断をまた始めるのは拒否するよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも、行く前に君に聞きたいことがあるんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: また寝てていいよ。6月に起こすから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日のことについて。限界についてかな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君が後で知りたいことについては話したけど、これについてはあまり話してないね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: コーヒーって言ったとき、コーヒーだけって意味だった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 違うよ。君が会う場所を選んだだけで、午後がどこで終わるかのルールじゃないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うまくいってもっといたいと思ったら、私たちが言ったことだけで帰る必要はないってこと？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もちろんそんなことないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君がやりたいことをしてほしいんだ。今朝作ったリストにあったかどうかを気にしないで

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もし彼にキスしたいなら？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: なら、キスしなよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君はそれを簡単に言うね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: すごく助かるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本気で言ってるから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それ以上に進みたい場合はどうするの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君に制限を設けるつもりはないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私からは制限なし。君が何をしたいかを決めてほしい、私が望むことじゃなくてね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当に。毎回許可を求める必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まだ自分がどう感じるかわからないな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう知っておく必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一杯のコーヒーを飲んで帰るかもしれないし、午後ずっと一緒にいたいかもしれないね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 計画に合わせるために自分を止めたり、私のために話を面白くしようと無理をしてほしくないんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨夜は大丈夫だったよ。今はやかんが沸く間に時間を確認してる

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それが心配だった部分だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 帰ってきて、やりすぎたか、足りなかったことで君を失望させた気分になるのが嫌だった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日を成功させるためにやらなきゃいけないことはないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: だから、私が本当に何を望んでいるのかを決めて、彼が何を望んでいるかも見るよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その通り

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そして、その途中で気が変わることもできるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もちろん。これは君が私たちのどちらかに約束することじゃないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは私が期待していたよりもずっと大きな答えだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう朝ごはん食べたよ、聞く前にね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨夜、急にもっとリアルに感じたって言ってたよね。それは変わった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 完全には変わってないよ。君が実際にそこにいることを考えると、まだ気づくから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: でも、緊張することが君の決断を私が代わりにしたいって意味じゃないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: リラックスすることを、私のために演じなきゃいけないことにしないでね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうしないよ。何か違うと感じたら教えるからね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いいよ。ちゃんとした答えを聞きたいんだ、たとえちょっと時間がかかっても。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 覚えててくれたんだね❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨夜みたいにまだ笑ってる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。ちょっと気が散ってるけど、あなたの気持ちを聞くのが楽しみだよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 家を出る前に、私の午後がどうなるか決めないでね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 代わりに、私にメッセージを送ってくる女の子に集中しようとしてる。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 素敵な人そうだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼女は❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 寝る前に明日の講義がほとんど聞こえてきたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}もいるのに？その後も彼に会うことになるのに？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。私たちが話しているのが誰かは忘れてないよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたを信じてるよ。デート中ずっと私を変だと思わせないように守ってほしいわけじゃないから。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼が今日、ちょっと時間が必要かもしれないね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨日のことをまだ理解しようとしてるの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 多分ね。「私の彼氏が知ってる」って言葉がまだ完全に受け入れられてない気がする。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼を驚かせる前に、何か注文させてあげて。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 二回目のプレゼンはしないよ。彼はなんとかなるでしょ😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは良い影響を与えるってことだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それに、まだ実際に知らない人に会うところだし。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その通り。選ぶ自由があるからって、急に彼に全てを信じなきゃいけないわけじゃないよね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まずはコーヒーを飲みながら彼がどんな人か見てみたい。それは変わってないよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: じゃあ、そこから始めればいいよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼のメッセージが好きだった。デート中に、自分が想像していたバージョンに合っているかどうか考えたくないんだ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当の彼の方がもっと面白いかもしれないよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼が料理をカフェに任せてくれれば、チャンスはあるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もう食べた？それともみんなを見守ってるだけ？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そして、私がいくつかのことを自分だけに留めておけると言ったとき、私たちは初デートのことだけを話してたよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その答えをもっと意味のあるものとして扱う前に、この部分を声に出して言いたかったの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そう言ってくれて嬉しいよ。今、私のためにコーヒーで止まるんじゃなくて、自分で選んでほしいってことが分かってくれたよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。私たちが誤解しないままで、いくつかのことは私のままでいいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。どちらかが心配することは、まだ私たちが話すべきことだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何が許されるかについて、すごく慎重な答えをくれると思ってた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ここに食べ物があるよ、ありがとう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 本を買うのに思ったより時間がかかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 数分後 – リビングルーム

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 対象が意図的に親密さを高めている

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: あの挨拶が、回を重ねるほど気軽なものには思えなくなる。自分の反応にも気づき始めた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAKは{{name:hailey}}が{{name:aiden}}の到着時に頬にキスをした証拠をアーカイブしました

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: いつから彼にキスするようになったの？
彼が私をトレーニングし始めてから😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 私のことをこんなに大事にしてくれるんだから、ちょっとご褒美をあげないとね
二人とも手に負えないわ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}がソファの前をゆっくり歩く
意図的な注目を引く行動

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 対象が露出の多い服を着て二人の男性の前を歩いた
やばい…彼女、本当に大人になったね👀

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: でも、どうやって遊ぶのかよくわからないんだ…😇
身体的接触がエスカレートした
対象がAidenの膝の上に座った
明らかに意図的な近接

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 二人が近づいているのは分かる。でも、自分がどこまで受け入れられるのかはまだ考えたい。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAKは{{name:hailey}}が遊び方を学ぶという名目で{{name:aiden}}の膝の上に座っているのを記録した

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: え？画面をちゃんと見たいんだよ😌
わざとやってるでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: そんな格好で下に降りてこないでね
でも文句は言わないよ😂

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: もちろん、あんたも彼女と同じくらい悪いよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 後でトレーニングがあるから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: みんなと遊ぶの楽しかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 二人ともそれをプライベートでやってくれる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: それが挑戦なら、もっと頑張るよ 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 今朝のことは代償を払わせるって警告したよね
{{name:aiden}}は君を見ようともしないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ねえ😊 家に帰って準備中だよ、ドレスは3回見直されても無事だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうみたいだね。まるで一章を見逃した気分だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私も時間がかかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここに来る前にまた話した？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今朝、そうだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: で？どうだったか聞いてもいい？それともプライベート？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いくつかはプライベートだけど、コーヒーが限界なのか聞いたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それを彼に聞いたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: はい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は何て言ったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 制限を設けたくないって。私が本当にやりたいことを決めてほしいんだって。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君は美しいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: マジで？そんな簡単に？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もっと長く話したけど、役に立つ部分だけ教えてあげるね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その会話をして真顔を保つのを想像してるんだけど。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日は最初の一文すら言えなかったじゃん。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 確かにその通り

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ私には変な感じ。悪くはないけど、変だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またデートの間ずっと説明することなくても変な感じになるかもね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その通りだね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが今日の終わり方についての約束を持ってきたわけじゃないよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。それは彼が何に同意したかを推測するんじゃなくて、あなたに聞くべきってことだね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これを着ると気分がいいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 正確に

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、最初の質問ね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 続けてください

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に窓側の席が欲しいの？それとも私がここに座ってたから他の席を取ったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 窓側の席が欲しかったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、私と席を交換して。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。椅子を選んでもいいよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これについてすごくうるさくなるつもりだよね？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたが好みがないふりをやめるまでだけどね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これが多すぎるかどうか聞こうと思ったけど、実は気に入ってることに気づいた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 生徒が席を交換する

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 意図したよりも視線が下に留まっている

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 二人に好奇心があるのは分かっていた。それでも、互いに向ける視線には不意を突かれる。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 見られちゃった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: コーヒーが届いた後

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 美味しい？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: すごく美味しいよ。小さくても楽しんでいいんだからね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 美味しいよ。イライラするくらい美味しい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だからまた来たくなるんだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それに、ランチラッシュを逃すと静かだしね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 時間を気にせずにここにいたことはないと思う

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いつも他に行くところがあるよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、その答えを大事にしてね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 授業、仕事、何か忘れたことがあるかも

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日は習慣でノートをバッグに入れそうになった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そこに置いておいていいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 置いてきたよ。それを言おうとしてるの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ごめんね。君がここにいることを楽しんでるんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはとても都合のいい素敵な答えだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: たまにそういうこともあるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。でも、いつもその後に3つのジョークがないと聞こえないんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日はそれに隠れないようにしてる

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 面白さをやめる必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、するよ ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった、だってハンサムで静かって疲れそうだもん

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あそこにいるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もし午後が丸々空いてたら、何をする？やるべきことじゃなくて、実際にやりたいこと

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 時間を気にせず散歩に行くかな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どこかに座って、何かを聞きながら、しばらくクラスのグループには返事しないかも

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 数本先に庭があるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その庭知ってる。いつも入り口の前を通るんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今回は中に入ってみようよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、そうしたいな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: カフェの外で

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他はどう感じてる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここを左だよね？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、同じブロックをぐるぐる回るつもりじゃなければ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君にツアーをしてるふりをすることもできるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が大学に通ってる場所の？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ改善の余地があるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: なんか怪しく静かだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がジョークを言うのを心配してたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全然話さないでって頼んだわけじゃないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しい時間を過ごしてるから、静かな瞬間を埋めたくないんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 緊張してるけど、キャンセルしたいとは思ってないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは新しいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好きだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し後、庭で

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 外の道よりもこっちの方がいいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここでは自分の考えが聞こえるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日はそれを少なくしたいと思ってたの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 調子はどう？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: カフェを出たら良くなったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: コーヒーの時、そんなにひどかった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何かをしなきゃいけない10分前みたいに、頭が役に立つことを言い尽くしちゃう感じ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ううん。次に何をすべきか考えるのをやめたの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それで、今は？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今、ちょっと止まってほしいな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ここで？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: はい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 危険なことを言いそうな顔してるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私は〜

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、ちょっと焦っちゃったかも

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: キスを始める

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: キスを返す

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: キスで、話していただけの時にはなかった現実味が生まれた。少し受け止める時間がいる。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 10分間ずっと考え続ける必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼を黙らせるために

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: こんにちは

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初にそれをしていいとは言ってないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君が歩くのを止めて、そんな風に見つめてきたから、リスクを取ったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはリスクじゃないよ。君が先に進んだだけだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: だから、これがどうなるかは当たってたね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今、自分に満足してるみたいだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: どうせ、キスしようとしてたでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 話し続けて、どうなるか見てみて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 大胆な提案だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またその決断を始めるつもりじゃないと思ってたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: え、また止めるつもり？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: しーっ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 正直に教えて、誰のキスが上手い？私それとも彼？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: え？それは正当な質問だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君はすべてを競争に変えるよね。ゲームでも、授業でも、人生でも

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そして今、キスでもそうみたいだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に知りたいなら、今のところ君はまだかなり遅れてるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わあ、それは冷たいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君が聞いたんだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ううん、気に入ったよ。今は挑戦みたいに聞こえるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そういうつもりじゃなかったんだけど

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう遅いよ。私はもう個人的に受け取ってるから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたは不可能です

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それなのに、私を黙らせるためにキスしたんだよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが今の私にとって言葉がどれだけ効果的かを示してるはずだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し座ってもいい？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。あそこ、日陰のところで

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 見て、尋問なしで座りたい場所を選ぶなんて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少しで一人で座ることになるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その日の午後遅く

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: バス停まで送ろうか？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それ、いいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今度の日に計画を立てたい？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今すぐはいいかな。今日は少し考える時間が欲しい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは丁寧な断り方じゃないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうは思ってないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった。これをやってよかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私もそう思う

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 家に着いたらメッセージしてね？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私は

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: さよならを言った後

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 帰る途中だよ❤️ いい午後だったね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった。気分はどう？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嬉しいし、思ったより静かだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全部一度に打ちたいと思ってたけど、今は少し考えたいだけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ゆっくりでいいよ。帰り道を報告にする必要はないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってる。でもこれを送ってあげたかったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 素敵な笑顔だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に午後の休みを取った気分。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やることの合間の隙間じゃなくて。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それがわかってくれて嬉しい。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 家に落ち着いたらちゃんと話せる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろん

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたの一日についても教えてね。私の話ばかりじゃつまらないから。
午後3時25分

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今向かってるって伝えるために、彼にサクッと写真を送ったよ
