story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 入る前にこれを撮ったの。中が明るくて好き。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ショッピングストリートのカフェにいるよ。大きな窓のそばのテーブルを見つけた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 早く着いたから、飲み物を選ぶのがすごく難しいふりをしてるの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が来る頃には、少なくとも決めてるだろうね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そう思うよね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 待って、外にいる。写真で見たことある！

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今、電話をしまうね。また後で話そうね❤️
午後3時30分

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これだよ、君に送った鏡のやつじゃなくて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 数分後

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 注文したよ、一緒に写真を撮るのが大丈夫か聞いてみた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼はいいよって言った。あなたにも送ってあげたいって言ったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少しリラックスしてるみたい。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 誰かと実際に話す方が、最初の一文を考えるより簡単だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: コーヒーを楽しんでね。後でどうだったか教えてね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうするね😊

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その日の午後遅く

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: コーヒーを越えて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少し後で

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 予定外のさよなら

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 後でね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 帰る途中だよ😊 うまくいったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 気分はどう？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: いいね。飲み物のメニューをテストがあるかのように勉強してた時よりも良かったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 会話を全部自分で持たなくてよかったのは嬉しかったな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その笑顔、いいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は期待通りだった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 最初はちょっと静かだったよ。だから緊張してたのが少し恥ずかしくなくなった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それから、彼は最初の10分間はピザの写真について説明しないと自分に約束したって言ってた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それで、彼はそれを守れた？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 約4分間だったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼が話すことがなくなったからじゃなくて、ストーリーを聞きたかったから聞いたんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それはいい理由だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その後、結局散歩したんだ。買うつもりじゃなかった古本まで持って帰ってきちゃった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 充実した午後だったね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 2枚撮ったよ。最初のは、ドアを閉めたかどうか思い出そうとしてるみたいだった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全く必要のない買い物だけど、気に入ってるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 緊張が収まったら、そこにいるのは楽しかった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん。うまくいってるかどうか考えるのをやめて、ただ楽しい時間を過ごしたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 小さな詳細は自分だけのものにしておくけど、その部分は知っておいてほしかったの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 行ってくれて嬉しいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私もだよ ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: さよならした後にこれを撮ったの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 閉めたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 変えるつもりはないよ。ただ、必要以上に真剣に見てるだけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嬉しそうだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうだよ。またお腹が空いてるみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちゃんと話す前に家に帰って食べたいんだけど、いいかな？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろん。どこにも行かないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたの一日についても聞きたいな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私のと競わなくても面白いよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 洗濯機で国際問題を起こさずに洗濯したよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ中にいたから、ないよ😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは進歩だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その過程で靴下が一つ失われたかもしれないけど

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その犠牲を忘れないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: やらなかったら文句を言ったでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 文句は言ってないよ。あなたがどれだけ褒められるか考えてるだけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 少なくとも少しはね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、よくやったね、イケメン。今夜、もっと詳しく話すね ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちなみに、今向かってるって伝えるために、彼にサクッと写真を送ったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ドアの前にいる私だけ、特に何もないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 二回送る必要ないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。もう私の全身チェックは終わってるしね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 廊下に立ってる理由を見つける前に、今行くね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全然違う

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しんでね。暇なときに話そう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今朝はありがとう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が次に何を望むか考えながらデートする必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。その部分は持っていくからね❤️
午後3時25分

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 道を渡る前にこれを撮ったよ。ランチの人混みがない方がずっといい感じ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 正確に

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: カフェの外にいるよ。{{name:aiden}}はもうここにいる

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は一番に着いたことに満足しすぎてるみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼に5分で会話を全部持っていかせないでね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう遅い、彼は腕時計を指差してる

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼がそれにも手を振り始める前に、携帯をしまうね
午後3時30分

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5分も早く着いた。心配になりかけたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not wearing a watch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 腕時計してないじゃん

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know what time it is without one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 時計がなくても、時間はわかるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: グループミーティングが時間通りに終わったから、ちゃんとランチも取れたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、私も早いってこと知ってるよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、ただ最初に来たことを楽しみたかっただけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これがデート全体の雰囲気になるの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう少し魅力的なところがあると思ってるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まあ、見てみよう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look really nice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: すごく素敵だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ありがとう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それだけだから。返事を考えなくても大丈夫だよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そんなことないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっとだけね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: よかった。デート中ずっとケーキのディスプレイを見つめてることはないね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今、考えさせられてるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ほら、揺れない椅子を二つ見つけたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは珍しく気が利いてるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: カップを見てから判断して。カップには何も手を加えてないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 飲み物が来る前に、一緒に写真を撮ってくれる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 撮るの？それとも写るの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Being in it. I can hold the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 写る方だよ。私が電話を持つから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a separate issue
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは別の問題だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For {{name:player}}?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}}に送るため？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like one too. But yes, I'd like to send it to him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私も一つ欲しいな。でも、彼に送るつもりだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. You can send it to me as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった。私にも送ってね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、もう少し近くに来て。肩しか写らないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have just asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ただ聞けばよかったのに

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did just ask. Look at the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちゃんと聞いたよ。電話見てみて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We found a table 😊 I asked for a photo before he could complain about the coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: テーブル見つけたよ😊 彼がコーヒーについて文句を言う前に写真を頼んだんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 二人ともメニューを巡って口論しそうな顔してるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We already did. This is the peaceful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もうやったよ。今は平和な時間だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted to show you before I leave
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 出発する前に見せたかったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 楽しんでね。また後で話そう❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So, how did this morning go?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: で、今朝はどうだった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 実際、仕事を終わらせたよ。パソコンが壊れそうだって言わなくてもよかったし

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それは残念だな。君が私のために逃げたと思いたかったのに

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君は午後をもらったよ。ドラマチックな背景を求めないでね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日のことをまだ考えてるんだよね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The look on your face is going to stay with me for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君の顔の表情はしばらく忘れられないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 君にフラートしてた時、彼がイライラすると思ってたけど、まさかこんな展開になるとは思わなかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼にはゲームで君と口論するだけじゃない事情があるんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Did you tell him you’d be back later?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼に後で戻るって言った？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then we can continue the lesson
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: じゃあ、レッスンを続けられるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This has moved well past a study session, and it's harder to laugh off now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: もう勉強の時間という範囲をはるかに越えている。笑って済ませるのは難しくなった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived the first kiss of the evening session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAKが今夜の最初のキスをアーカイブした

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I also have ways to give punishments and rewards… without being the teacher 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 私も罰とご褒美を与える方法があるんだから… 教師じゃなくてもね😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject initiated a handjob during the private session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 被験者がプライベートセッション中に手を使った

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On this subject… you don’t seem to need any lessons
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: この件について… あなたはレッスンが必要ないみたいね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’ll probably go revise directly at his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼の家で直接修正するつもりだよ
被験者が完全にコントロール

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject increased the intensity of the act
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 被験者が行為の強度を増した

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: They finish with a kiss while she makes him cum
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼女が彼をイかせながらキスで終わる
セッションは射精で終了
いいセッションだったね…

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we still need to revise now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: でも、今は復習しないと

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But it’s going to be hard to focus after that 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: あんなことした後じゃ、集中するの難しいよね😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’ll drop me off a bit later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 少し後に送ってくれるって

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know… but we have to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: わかってる…でもやらなきゃ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m not the one who’s going to get eaten
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 私が食べられるわけじゃないから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On the contrary… I’m the one who’s going to eat him 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 逆に…私が彼を食べるんだから😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I know you like it 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: でも、あなたがそれを好きなのは知ってるよ😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know you liked the show 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: あんたがそのショー好きなの知ってるよ😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little reward just for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: あんたのためのちょっとしたご褒美
あんたは恥知らずだね
でも美しくてセクシー

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Since when do you act like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: いつからそんな風に振る舞うようになったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m done living only for revisions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: もう修正だけの生活は終わりにする

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 少しは人生を楽しみたいんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I’ve always had a crush on him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 彼にずっと恋してたし

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It seems like it’s mutual… so I’m taking advantage 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: どうやら彼もそうみたい…だから利用させてもらうね😇

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 私の前でそんなことして恥ずかしくないの？
あんたのことは知ってるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 全然気にしてないでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ ❤️ シャワーを浴びて何か食べたよ。ちゃんと話す時間ある？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まさにそれが君の映画の選び方だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼も似たようなことを言ってたよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんな風に会話が脱線するのは楽しかった。初デートだってことを考えるのをやめたよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼の印象と何か違ったところはあった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はメッセージから想像してたよりも、答えるまでに長く聞いてくれた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初は awkwardなことを言ったのかと思ったけど、実際には彼が私の質問について考えてたんだ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 必ずしも悪いことじゃないよね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ううん。間を埋めようとするのをやめたら、楽しくなったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は私たちが会うことを知ってるか確認してくれたけど、私がそこにいることを弁護する必要があるかのように君のことを何度も持ち出すことはなかったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、彼が何かについて確信がなかったら、私に聞いてきた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: やっとちゃんと座れた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは君を知るいい方法だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんな感じだったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 散歩の途中で手を繋いでた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本屋の外で、キスしてもいいか聞いたの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: キスしたかったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: さよならの準備をしてるとき、もう一つの理由を考えようとしてる自分に気づいた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、本当にしたかったことを言ったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼もそれを望んでたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はそうした

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 言葉を見つけるのはちょっと気まずかった。キスはそうじゃなかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 帰り道ずっと考え込むより、聞いてみてよかったと思った

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうしてくれて嬉しいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も。今朝は二杯目を飲みたいかどうかもわからなかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一午後で彼のことをよく知っているふりはしないけど、楽しい午後だった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜は大きな決断をする必要はないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってる。彼に会えて楽しかったって言ったし、また話すつもり

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 言った通り、すべての瞬間を説明するつもりはないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは快適そうですね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことしなくていいよ。今どうしてるか教えて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 幸せ。ちょっと考え込んでるけど、怒ってはいないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そこにいたかったから残ったし、帰りたくなったら帰った

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 午後を特定の時間に引き延ばそうとしたり、大きなものにしようとは思ってなかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 言いたいことを言うのは楽だった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。頭の中でリハーサルをやめたらもっと楽になった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今は自分の中に留めておきたいこともあるけど、君に言えないことで心配していることはないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが私にとって大事なこと

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 理由を細かく説明しなくても、楽しんだって言えるのが好き

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すべての詳細を知らなくても、君のために幸せでいられるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: めっちゃそう。あの靴は良い選択だったけど、家に入ったらすぐ脱ぎたかった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね。だって私は幸せだよ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたはどうだった？今日は実際にどんな感じだったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが会うって知ってたから、いつもより時間を気にしてたよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから電話を置いて、午後のことを始めた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 心配してた？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5歩しか歩けない靴を選ばなくてよかった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 主に、昨夜話したように、これが本当だって気づいてた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、キャンセルするように言っておけばよかったなんて思ってなかったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何も感じてなかったふりをするんじゃなくて、そう言ってくれて嬉しい。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 楽しかったって聞けて嬉しいよ。あなたらしい声が聞けて好き。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はまだ私だよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってるよ。明日会うのを楽しみにしてる。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたはどうだった？今日は期待通りだった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 正直、何を期待していいかわからなかった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: たまには自分の失敗から学ぶよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが出かけてくれて嬉しかったけど、プレイしてたゲームよりもあなたのメッセージを待ち遠しく感じてた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはすごい成果だね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても大きな成果だよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 主に、あなたが戻ってきたときの声が好きだった。私が聞きたいことだけを言ってるわけじゃなかったから。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 違うよ。いい午後を過ごしたから、あなたと話したかったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが私を幸せにしてくれた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: また会いに行ってハグしたくなっちゃうよ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他のことを話す前に、今朝言ったことが本当に助かったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: カフェでの一緒の写真、気に入った？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだね。その瞬間に私を含めてくれて嬉しかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちなみに、最初に彼に聞いたよ。それを撮って君に送ることについて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知ってるよ、君が教えてくれたから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから電話を置いたんだ。デート中ずっと次のことを送るのに時間を使いたくなかったから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなことしなくてもよかったよ。君が本当に共有したいと思ってくれたものをもらえて嬉しかったから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分で選ぶことについて？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 後で自分の言葉でそれについて話せてよかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが私の望みだったんだ。君は私のためにデート中ずっと物を集める必要はなかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、帰る途中の彼女の写真も撮れたしね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その部分が特に好きだったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君の普通の特権はそのままだよ 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: さよならするまで電話を放っておくのが助けになったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君と話したくなかったわけじゃないよ。ただ、同時に二つの会話をするつもりはなかったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今、ちゃんと話せる方が好きだな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も。楽しむ時間があるときに君の注意を引きたかったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自分だけの瞬間を持つことが、今夜君と距離を置くことにはならないのが好きだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 距離を置きたかったわけじゃないよ。君が自分らしくいるためのスペースが欲しかったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを実際に経験した今、気持ちが違うよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初は、次に何をするかについてあなたがどう思うか考えてしまった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、帰れたよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日のランチの後、空いてる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 映画と不合理な量のパスタを持った女性のためなら？うん

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかった。君に会いたいな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 容器を持ってくるから、私の映画の選択に同意したことを忘れたふりはさせないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 覚えてるよ。ソファにスペースも作ったし

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のため、それともパスタのため？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が来たら優先順位について話そう

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 残念、違うよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君のためだよ。パスタには椅子を用意するから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ずっと良くなった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その後、あなたが指示を待ってるわけじゃないって思い出した。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今日は君の隣に座れなくて寂しかったな

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日は好きなだけ食べていいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうするつもりだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今、疲れてる？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少しだけ。辛い感じじゃなくて、ただ画面を見るのをやめたくなってきた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここで寝ちゃう前にベッドに入らせて

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7分後

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 着いたよ。携帯の充電も忘れずにしたし

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 整理整頓された女性だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっとだけね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 待ってなかったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これ、置く前に君のためだけに送るね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そこにいたらいいのに

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日ね。そして、映画についての私の素晴らしい解説を直接聞けるよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは訪問に含まれてるの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを消すことはできないよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなつもりじゃなかったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ、ハンサム ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ、かわいい子。いい一日だったみたいでよかったね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も。あなたに会えるのが楽しみだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: すぐにあなたに質問にしなくても、何かを欲しいと思えるのが良かった。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがあなたに持っていてほしかったこと。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが行っていいって言ったから、さらに進もうとしてたわけじゃないよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それも違いを生んだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね。私からの制限は、達成すべき目標になるはずじゃなかったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうじゃなかったよ。今回は正しい答えを出そうとしてなかったからね 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。全部置いて、ポケットに入れたばかりの電話を探すのに5分かかったよ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: カフェの後、数本先の小さな庭に行ったんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: デート中、彼はどうだった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 相変わらずの彼だったよ。注文する前からカップについて文句言ってたし

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: でも、何を言うべきかわからないときは、いつもより正直だったよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君が彼にイライラすると思ってたから、まだこれに慣れようとしてたって認めてたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 想像できます

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私たちの会話を全部は話さなかったよ。ただ、君が許可したリストに従ってないって言っただけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ぼーっとしてたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はそれをどう受け止めたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はまた驚いてた。その後、私が何を望んでいるか聞くべきだって理解したみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その後、状況について話すのをやめて、実際にデートを楽しんだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それを説明するのを乗り越えられてよかったね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も。彼は私の小さなことをたくさん覚えていてくれた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして、彼がすぐに冗談にしないで、いいことを言ってくれるのを聞けたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それだけで二杯目のコーヒーの価値があるね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは言わないで。彼はすべての褒め言葉を公表し始めるから

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから庭に立ち寄って、{{name:aiden}}が私にキスしたの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼が最初にキスしたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。私が何を言うか決める前にキスされたんだ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し彼を押し返したよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大丈夫だった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、ちょっと驚かされただけ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一瞬待ってほしかったのに。彼は止まったけど、すぐに自分に満足そうな顔をし始めた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは彼らしいですね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どうやら彼は私がどうせキスするつもりだと思ってたみたいで、先に行こうとしてた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん、彼は自分が正しい方法を見つけたわけね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まさにその通り 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はそれについてずっとからかってきたの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なくした靴下、見つかった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、黙らせるために自分からキスしたの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、したかったから？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。イライラすることに、その二つが同時に起こったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 黙らせるのはうまくいった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: キスの間だけはね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それから、彼は誰がキスが上手いか、彼か私かを聞いてきた。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本当にそんなこと聞いてきたの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。どうやらとても重要な質問だったみたい。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼には、すべてを競争に変えるって言ったの。ゲームも授業も、どうやらこれもね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それで彼は黙ったの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 袖の中にあったよ。どうやってそこに入ったのか、誰もわからない。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろんではありません

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: だから、今のところ彼はまだかなり遅れてるって言ったの。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今のところ？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ああ、あなたも始めないで。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 午後は一人の競争好きなバカと過ごしたの。今夜はもう一人はいらない。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ただ自分のリードを楽しんでるだけだよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして私の言ってることを証明してるのよ😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はどう反応したの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は笑って、私が挑戦を与えたと思ったみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私はそれが挑戦のつもりじゃなかったって言ったけど、どうやら関係なかったみたい

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの洗濯機、ちょっとしたユーモアがあるね。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは正しい感じだね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたがその行動に気づくと思ってたよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のために悪く聞こえるようにしなくてもいいのに

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうじゃないよ。彼とキスするのは好きだった、たとえその後が大変でも

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう言ってくれて嬉しいよ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そして二回目は、驚いたり何をすべきか考えたりしなかった。ただしたかっただけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その後は変だった？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一瞬だけね。その後彼がまた話しすぎて、考えすぎるのをやめた

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: しばらく日陰に座ってた。彼が何でもコメントし続けるなら、一人で座らせるって脅したの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ロマンスは健在だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その報告、気に入ってくれると思ったんだ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは同じ女性を愛してる。自分が何にサインしたか分かってるでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はまた計画を立てようとしたけど、まだこのデート中に次のデートを整理したくなかった

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは納得だね

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼を遠ざけるつもりじゃなかった。ただ家に帰って、今日を少し落ち着かせたかっただけ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: カフェの後に散歩に行ったって言ったでしょ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼が見たかった本屋があったから、結局古本の棚を見て回ったの

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがその本の出所なの？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。説明が馬鹿げてると思ったから選んだの。物語がどれだけひどいか知りたかったんだ。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、あなたの平凡な冒険にも興味あるよ。

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person
You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: ちなみに、また私を褒めてもいいからね
君、欲張りになってるね
今朝は柔らかそうだね
私は欲張りじゃないよ
基準を維持してるだけ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: しばらく起きるつもりはないよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 一日中そこにいるつもり？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 誰かが邪魔しに来ない限りね
君が覚えてるか確認してるだけ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 君が起きて、何もなかったことにするんじゃないか心配だった

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 今日は発表するんだけど、突然自己紹介が不慣れに見える 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: また君だけが観客だといいな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私、ちょっと偏ってるかも

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 君はすごく偏ってるね。好きだよ ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ちゃんと聞いてたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: そうだね。だから、全部書き直す代わりに君にメッセージしてるんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 準備完了。ノートも確認したし、ノートパソコンも充電済み、君のところにバッグも置き忘れてないよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: じゃあ、もう昨日より進んでるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: バッグのことは思い出させないで 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: いい感じだね。さあ、君がそのテーマを知ってることを見せてきて

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 昨夜、ノートなしで乗り切ったやつと同じ？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 後でどうだったか教えるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 待ってるね。頑張って、愛してる ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ありがとう。愛してる

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: うん。私の脳が疑うにはとても不便なタイミングを選んじゃった

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 昨日ははっきり説明してくれたじゃん

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: スライドを探さずに私の質問にも答えてくれたし

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: わかってる。でもみんなが私を見てると違うんだよね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 始める前に少し考えて。最初の文に急ぐ必要はないよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 緊張すると急いじゃうんだよね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: じゃあ、カフェの例を思い出して。それを説明するのは完璧にわかってたじゃん

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: わかった。落ち着いて、例から始めてみて

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: じゃあ、今夜また寄るね。

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: わかった。今夜、遊びに行ってもいい？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: もう決めた後で聞いてるんだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 今夜来たらドアは開けておくから。

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 遊びに来る準備ができたらメッセージしてね。
部屋はきれいじゃないよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 君の部屋に行こうかなって考えてる

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 何が待ってるか知っておいてね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 部屋のこと言ってるわけじゃないよね？
今日はすごくストレートだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 冷静な君はどこに行ったの？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 人生を楽しむことにしただけ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 終わったよ。そしてうまくいった 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: すごく聞いたことあるよね😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: まさにそれについて話してたから、思わず笑いそうになったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ノートを見なくても答えられたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: それは素晴らしいね。もう知ってたんだ、ただ言う練習が必要だっただけだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: そうみたいだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: でも、完璧ではなかったけどね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 何があったの？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 最初のスライドを説明してる間に、次のスライドに進んじゃったんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: それから、戻りすぎちゃった

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: プレゼンのサプライズツアーだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 彼女が来たよ。気分はどう？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: その通り。みんながタイトルを2回も楽しめたね😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 正しいスライドをまた見つけられた？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: うん。ノートパソコンの方が私よりもせっかちだって言ったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 何人かが笑ってくれた。その後、続けたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: それはかなりいいリカバリーだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 私もそう思ったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: まだ成績は出てないけど、教授が例は明確だったって言ってたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: それについては満足すべきだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: そうだよ❤️ 昨日助けてくれて嬉しかったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 役に立って嬉しいよ。プレゼンは自分でやったんだから

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ほっとした。始める前は息を止めてたと思う

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: これで静かな時間があるたびに文を練習する必要がなくなるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: じゃあ、その静かな時間を楽しんでね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 今度はランチもちゃんとしたものをね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 学業の成功に素晴らしいフォローアップだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 今夜話そう？あなたの一日も聞きたいな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: もちろん。ランチを楽しんでね、愛しい人

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: うん、楽しむよ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 自己紹介は思い出せた？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: うん。言った通りにペースを落としたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: カフェの例に入ったら、すごく楽になったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: いいね。質問はどうだった？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: これ、気に入ると思うよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 教授が、似たような商品と価格の2つの場所の間で、何が選ばせるかを聞いてきたんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: それ、聞いたことあるな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: どれくらい近づくべきか

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}}が携帯を下ろしてあなたを見る
ちょっと気に入ってるよ
君がそうするとは100%確信してなかったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAKがプライベートルームでの親密な距離の証拠をアーカイブした

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 君が僕に寄りかかってるんだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: そんな目で見てたら、またキスしちゃうよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: なんでまだメッセージしてるの？
この緊張感を楽しんでるんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAKがプライベートな場所での親密なキスの証拠をアーカイブした

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 昨日よりも良かったね
でも、ここでやめた方がいいよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If we keep going I won’t want to stop
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 続けたら、やめたくなくなるから

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And if I don’t want to stop either?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: もし僕もやめたくなくなったら？
そんなこと言わないで
こんなに近くにいるときは特に

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 気が変わる前に部屋に戻って
だって、こっちの方が楽だから
それと…来てくれてありがとう

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 今声に出して話したら、変な感じになっちゃうから

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: ちょっと…メッセージさせて

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 君、どうしたらいいかわからないみたいに立ってるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 家に着いたよ、今夜のためにそのスライドをしまってるところ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 遊びに来て、一緒に夜を過ごさない？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ディナー、一緒の時間、そして最後に帰らなくていいんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うん❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: うんうんうんうんうんうんうん❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それ、すごくいいな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 昨日聞こうと思ってたんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 聞いてくれればよかったのに。そそられたかも

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: でも明日の方がいいよ。即興じゃなくて必要なものを持っていけるし

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いつ来れる？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 大学の後は午後が空いてるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: よく頑張ったね。残りの一日はどうだった？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 家に帰って、荷物を取って、5時頃に行くね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 5時がいいね。

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今回は、近くに来てって言われたら、ちゃんといるからね🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それを楽しみにしてるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 待って。忘れ物しないように今バッグを取ってくるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 数分後

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 歯ブラシ、木曜日のための清潔な服、充電器

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: すごく整理整頓されてるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 頑張ってるよ。寝るためのTシャツを借りてもいい？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 良かったよ。プレゼンのことを考えなくなったら、すごく楽になった

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もちろん。前に私の着てたの似合ってたよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、私のために選んでくれる？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 準備しておくよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それに愛着が湧くかもしれないって知ってるよね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そのリスクを取るよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: はい、ほぼ詰め終わったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それについてすごく嬉しそうだね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうだよ。このバッグは明日あなたのところに置いていくつもりなんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: その持ち主も一緒にね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 何をしたの？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 特にその持ち主❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 実は、荷造りを終える前に...
