story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 何してるの？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ちょっとしたプレビューを見せてるの🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 数分後

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: どう思う？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: すごく綺麗だよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: その笑顔は、あなたが何をしてるか分かってたってことを教えてるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ちょっと気をそらしたかったの😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いくつかの用事、短い散歩、それから家の周りのことを少し

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 成功したよ。今、あなたがここにいてほしいな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もし私がそうだったら、どうする？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君を引き寄せて、そのバッグを開ける前にキスするよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、荷物を開けるのは後回しにするね ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 待って。着替える前にもう一つ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 1分後

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: はい、今夜の最後のプレビューだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 明日がすごく危険に感じるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 実際に君の前に立ったときの君の顔を見るのが楽しみだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 散歩はどうだった？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 近くに来てくれれば、私がどれだけ好きか分かるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうするつもりだよ 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: その写真は自分だけのために取っておいてね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もちろん。私たちの間だけにしておくよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いいね。明日は携帯を置いて、私に直接注意を向けてね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君には私の全ての注意を向けるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それが聞きたかったの ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君が全部の布団を奪うことを心配した方がいいかな？

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もし私からとても遠くで寝るつもりならだけど

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そんなつもりはなかったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 良かったよ。まだゆっくりだけど、外に出るのは気持ちよかった

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: じゃあ、大丈夫だね 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: でも、冷たい足を君にくっつけないとは約束できないよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それは招待状には書いてなかったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女付きの特典だよ。詳細を読んでおくべきだったね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: なんとかなるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: いいね。私が起きたときにも君がそばにいてほしいな

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君のそばにいるよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それがずっと考えている部分だよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君と一緒にいて、帰る時間を気にしなくていいこと

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 昨日、君がそばにいてくれて嬉しかったよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 嬉しいよ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 明日はそんな風に過ごせるね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 待ってる時間が長く感じるよ 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 明日の午後までだけどね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 荷造りを終わらせて、時間を見ないようにするよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 夕食に何か持ってきてほしいものがあったら教えてね

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君とバッグだけで大丈夫。食べ物は私が用意するから

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今回は両方一緒に到着するよ 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: おやすみ、愛しい人。明日が楽しみだよ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も。おやすみ ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 明日について聞きたいことがあるんだ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 何か考えてることある？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: おはよう❤️ 私の髪のゴムはまだ無事？それともあなたのソファが奪った？
そのクッション、とても魅力的だね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あんたのことを話してたの、バカ
その褒め言葉、いただくね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: よかった、もう一つ説明する時間ないからね😌
忙しい朝なの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まず授業、その後仕事。今準備中だよ
今日は髪を下ろしてるの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: もしあんたの警備員がヘアタイも持ってきてくれるならね
彼は現場でしか働いてないよ
ひどいサービスだね
私の鍵の隣にあるよ
ほら、これなしで準備完了だよ😊
素敵に見えるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、イケメン❤️ 今日は何してるの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 洗濯して、その後始めたゲームを終わらせたいな

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 遊ぶ前に洗濯物を干してね
わかってるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 湿った服の山より、あんたのゲームの話を聞きたいな😭
先にそれを終わらせるよ
あんたを信じることにするね
それもなくすんだね😭
遅くまで働いてるの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: また5時に終わるはずだから、そのまま帰るよ
良い一日を！

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あんたもね。まだあんたのソファにいたいけど、バスが待ってくれないから
あんたの席、取っておくね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それと私のヘアタイもね😌 大好きだよ
私も愛してるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それを守る人を置くよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、ちゃんと扱ってあげないとね
よく眠れましたか？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、前の夜より良かった

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その毛布の下にもう一時間は居られたかも
ほとんどそうだったよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 居心地が良くて、あなたと一緒にいるのが好きだった❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: こっちに来るって言ったでしょ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
You're going to be punished for that.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: それに対して罰を受けることになるよ。
対象が身体接触を開始しました
学術的な環境が完全に妨害されています

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: こんなに個人的な関係になっていたと目にして、胃が沈むような気分だ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAKは、対象が個別セッション中にデジタル挿入を開始したことを記録しました。
まだ復習について文句言ってるの？
二次的な身体接触が検出されました
衝撃音が記録されました
対象の反応は受け入れを示しています

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 彼女が本当はどう感じているのか知りたい。HAKの解釈だけじゃ足りない。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 刺激の後、教授は対象の背中をしっかり叩きました。対象は引き下がりませんでした。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: まだ注意を払ってるか確認してただけ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: これを楽しみすぎてるよ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: このプライベートレッスン、実際に好きになり始めてる。
気をつけて。ちょっと本音っぽかったよ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: すでに…取り決めがあるのに、なんでまだ修正しなきゃいけないの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 思ったより時間がかかった

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 君が僕と一緒に働いてることを証明する必要があるから。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: それはただの書類のため？
君って本当に責任感のある大人だね。
誰かがそうしなきゃね。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ねえ😊 今日はプリンターの横で食べる代わりに、ランチ用のベンチを見つけたよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 干してあるよ、証拠を求める前にね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 素晴らしい、あんたを誇りに思うよ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 戻らなきゃ。出たらメッセージするね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 後で話そうね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その日の午後遅く、彼らがマネージャーのオフィスで翌日のスケジュールを確認している間...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} の近くでオフィスの会話が検出されました

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日一緒にいた時は、あんなに自然でいられた。なのにまたあの職場を見て、一晩うまくいったくらいじゃ何も変わらなかったのかと怖くなる。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 髪を下ろしてるといい感じだね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: それが今日の午後の仕事への貢献なの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あんたを見ながらスケジュールも読めるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、二つ目をやってみて

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 大きな改善だね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ずっと面白くないね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私を見続けてたら、もっと時間がかかるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全然控えめじゃなかったね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうしようとしてたわけじゃないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明確に

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明日来て。私が夕食を作るから

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたの家に？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そこが私のキッチンだから

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が聞いてる理由、わかってるでしょ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事の話をするために呼んでるわけじゃないってわかってるよね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 背景音もずっと良くなるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日これについて話したじゃん

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日は予定があったでしょ。私は明日のことを聞いてるの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その会話の残りの部分のことを言ってたの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼とすごく楽しい夜を過ごしたの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうだろうね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、何か足りないって直そうとしてるみたいな態度やめて

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何かを直そうとしてるわけじゃないよ。あなたともう一度夜を過ごしたいの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたは全てを簡単に聞こえさせるね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 夕食は簡単だよ。その後のことを考えてるんでしょ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がそこにいるべきかどうか考えてるの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何を持ってるの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: この前の夜、楽しんだでしょ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: でもその後、私はすごく嫌な気持ちになったの。その部分をいつも省いてるよね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたを一晩独り占めできて嬉しかった。またやりたいな

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は答えを出さないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ考えてみて。来ることに決めたら、7時ね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まずこれを終わらせて

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}}は机の上の開いているスケジュールに戻る

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女のマネージャーは椅子に寄りかかりながら、向こう側から彼女の尻を見ている

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 目の前の仕事より、彼女を見ている。これをやめてほしいのは俺だけなんだと思えてしまうのが嫌だ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Invitation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 招待状

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 5時前に、スケジュールを確認して最後のページにサインをして...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: これで全部。これを他のと一緒に置いておくね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ラップサンドとリンゴ。特に大したことはないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そこに置いておいて、私が持っていくから

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私が整理する前に言ってくれればよかったのに

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今は整理されてるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたは本当に責任を持つのが好きなんだね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ちょっと私を見て

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 何？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう一度キスがしたい

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 私がためらってる理由、わかってるでしょ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかってるよ。あなたも欲しいか聞いてるの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: わかった... じゃあ、ただのキスね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼女の答えの後、マネージャーは立ち上がり、{{name:lena}}に近づく

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 彼は彼女にキスをしようと近づき、腰を少し引き寄せる。彼女もそのキスを返す。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: またキスをして、彼女も応じている。一緒に過ごした夜は今も大切なのに、今は痛いほど遠く感じる。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もう一度キス

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: はい、もう十分だよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: その方が書類仕事より好きだったよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 昨日はもう二度とそんなことは起こらないって自分に言い聞かせてた。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今日は今日の決断の方が好きだったな

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: もちろんそうだよね。罪悪感を抱えて帰るのはあなたじゃないし。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: あなたにキスするのが好きだった。そんなことなかったふりはしないよ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今出発するね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 後で夕食についてメッセージするね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 穏やかそうだね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: まだ同意してないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 聞いたよ。考えてみて

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 仕事を終えて、バス停に向かう途中...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 出たよ❤️ 今帰るところ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 全部終わった？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、明日のスケジュールがやっと終わったよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今夜は心配しなくていいことだね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: うん、一つ減ったね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 中に入ったらメッセージするね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、また後で話そう

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: そうだよ。10分間、どこに何があるか聞かれないのを楽しんでるの

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: じゃあ、洗濯の監督は休みなの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 本当に干してあるならね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 最近、このプライベートレッスンにすごく楽しそうだね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 今では彼に会うのが楽しみなんだ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 前は毎回の追加セッションに文句言ってたじゃん

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: もしくは、ただ勉強の仕方を見つけただけかも
ちょっと驚いてるだけだよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: もう私を尋問するのはやめて、寝なよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 帰ってくるとき、いい気分で笑ってるから

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 誰かが私の教授に嫉妬してるみたいだね
全然そんなことないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 彼は本当に自分の仕事が上手なんだ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: やあ❤️ 家に着いたよ。ゲームは終わった？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても華やかな夜を計画してるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは快適そうですね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだよ❤️ あなたのソファにはもっといい仲間がいたけど。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 昨夜撮ったその写真、保存したよ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もそうしたよ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having you here
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ここにいてくれて嬉しかったよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本当にそうだった。そういうのが恋しかったよ。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次回はもっと面白いものを見つけるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その映画はあまり気にしてないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが間違ったところで笑ってるのが、半分の楽しみだったしね。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: まだ終わってないよ、同じところで1時間も詰まってる。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どうやらそれが今の私の役割みたい。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがとても上手だね😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し後、彼女のマネージャーからメッセージが届く...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 数分後、あなたの会話に戻ると...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ああ、明日は少し遅く帰るかも。

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 仕事の人たちが何人かディナーをしてるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君のマネージャーも？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: はい

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A group thing this time?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今回はグループでの集まり？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, a few of us
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、何人かいるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何か違うことを試してみた？😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった、戻ったら教えてね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、するよ ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一晩中携帯をチェックする必要はないよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君にメッセージするのを忘れないから

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I did have a lovely time yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 昨日は素敵な時間を過ごしたよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already told me 😊
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう言ったじゃん 😊

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってる、ただもう一度言いたかっただけ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: お皿を片付けて、ベッドに入るね

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いくつか試したよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: おやすみ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. Love you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君もね、ハンサム。愛してるよ ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も愛してるよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Including blaming the controller?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: コントローラーのせいにすることも？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the first thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが最初のことだったよ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very thorough 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても徹底的だね😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何してるの？

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう着替えたよ。簡単なものを作って、あまり動かないつもり。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: よし、ベッドから引きずり出しに行くよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}}は無視されたメッセージの後、{{name:hailey}}をベッドから引きずり出した

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: なのにまだベッドにいるのはあなただけ
{{name:player}}は明かりをつけたままにした

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
Don’t make me come up there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 私を上に呼び寄せないで

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ねえ😊 今日はアラームなし、朝ごはんの後に着替えることにしたよ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 朝からずっと守ってたんだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼女が家を出る前に

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: オッケー、食べ物と映画、そして今回はちゃんと合う蓋も持ってるよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 小さな遠征の準備をしたみたいだね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君がナプキンを十分持ってるとは信じられないからだよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君自身を持ってきて。あとは交渉可能だから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは文句を言うのをやめさせるくらい良かったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 静けさを楽しんでおくよ、続く間はね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 長くはないよ。今向かってるからね❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 次の20分間は、完全にそうだよ😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その後、パン屋の近くの小さな市場に行くつもりだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何か必要なもの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: たまには同じ道を使わずに家を出たいんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それと、後であなたと一緒に食べるおいしいものが必要なんだ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: パスタはおいしいと思ったけど

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだね。でも、パスタはデザートにはならないよ、どんなに褒めてもね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 午後の計画が台無しだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私が選んだ映画も見るんだからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 覚えてるよ。神秘的な停電は手配してないからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはなんだか休みっぽいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはダメだよ。やっと君が結末を教えてない映画を見つけたんだから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは一度あったよね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君はその兄が話す前から怪しいって言ってたよね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼は室内で手袋をしてたんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼は皿を洗ってたんだよ 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 説得力のある変装だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は君の探偵ごっこはお休みしてね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだよ😌 今日はシフトもないし、どこにも急がなくていいの

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: メッセージの間の沈黙が何を意味するのか考えるんじゃなくて、君の顔を見るのが楽しみだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その沈黙は、正しい言葉を探してたからなんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: わかってるよ。今日は普通の人みたいに口をいっぱいにして話してもいいからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それならできるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いいね。君と楽しい午後を過ごしたいんだ、また真面目な会議じゃなくてね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨晩君がすごく嬉しそうだったから、その表情を見たくて来ちゃうところだったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は午後にじっくり見ていいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 窓を開けて、まだ熱いコーヒーを飲んでるよ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうするつもりだよ。すごく近くからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あまり得意げに見えないようにするよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは素敵な変化だね 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その後、家にいるの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まだ夕方の予定は決めてないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それが今日の好きなところの一つだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 慣れない体験だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}がさっきアーケードの看板の写真を送ってくれたよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: また負けたことを愚痴る場所を見つけたの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: どうやら彼は私の休みに役立つ提案をしてくれたみたい

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それが彼のやり方だよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今日は午後にあなたと予定があるって彼に言ったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼はエアホッケーのテーブルが中立の場になるかどうか聞いてみてって言ってたよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼が負けるまではね。その後はテーブルも陰謀に巻き込まれるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 後で行くかもしれないよ。彼がそれを説明しようとするのを見るのが楽しみだな

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 勝った後に三回勝負を受けない方がいいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 本当に。これに慣れたら、住みにくくなるかもね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それメモしておくね😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨日の彼が、私たちが見た本についてメッセージを送ってきたよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: お店のやつ？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。どうやら最初のページを見るために帰る価値があったみたい

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私は裏表紙しか読んでないから、彼にはまだ得意にならないように言ったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ブッククラブの良いスタートだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ほとんどは、話し続けたいって言わない新しい方法を見つけることだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 気づいてたんだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: かもね？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 後で遠回しなことはやめるかもね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今のところ、彼にはあなたと午後を過ごすって言ったよ。今晩話そうね😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: いいね。スマホと私の素晴らしい映画のコメントを共有したくないからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはバッグに置いておくよ。コメント用だから、あなたのためじゃないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだね、ベーカリーが私が欲しいものを全部売り切れる前にちゃんと服を着なきゃね😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まだ何が欲しいか決めてないじゃん

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: だから選択肢が必要なのよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 調査を待ってるね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私が着く前に全部のお菓子食べちゃダメだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 気をつけて、何を持っていくかまだ考えてるからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その日の午前中

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ちょっとしたアップデート: ベーカリーのおばさんが私を覚えてた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それはいいですね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私がいつもパンだけ買うって言ってるのを覚えてた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたの弁護にはあまり良くないね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 彼女はすでに大きな袋を手に取ってた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは絶対にただのパンじゃないね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そこにはパンがあるよ。どこかにね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私たちのために2つのリンゴパイを買ったし、帰り道が楽しくなるくらいの他のものも買ったよ🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嬉しそうだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: そうだよ。次にどこに行くべきか考えずに10分間花を見てた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何も買わなかった。ただそこにいるのを楽しんでた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: こんな日をもっと持ちたいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、そうだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 容器を取りに家に帰るね。それから、言った通りランチの後に行くよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 1時半で大丈夫？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 完璧

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 飲み物は冷蔵庫に入れておくね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私のソファの側は空けておいてね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何もしないことにもう慣れたみたいだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: これを着た私のお尻、見た？ 😌
あなたも楽しんでるでしょ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ジムに行くの？それともコーチとのデート？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: また不適切な服を探してるんじゃないよね？
あなたは本当に手に負えないね
ずいぶん大胆なスポーツウェアだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 午後は友達と過ごす予定
多分少し仕事するかな
あなたが生産的になってるね😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ まだ通りを少し下っただけなのに、君の映画の理論が意味不明な理由をもう一つ思いついたよ😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次はどうする？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フォトブースが魅力的だね😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私の敗北の証拠を残すため？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 違うよ、君が顔をしかめずに4枚撮れるか見てみたいから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ありえないね。それはすごく不公平な挑戦だよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 数分後、フォトブースで

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少なくとも1枚は台無しにするってわかってるよね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少なくとも1枚？それは楽観的だね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、もっと近くに来て。あらゆるアドバンテージが必要なんだ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フォトブースはそんな風には動かないよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほとんど君が持ってきたよね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 遅すぎるよ。カウントダウンが始まったから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 被写体がフォトブースに入る

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一連の個人的な写真が撮影される

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女に夜を楽しんでほしい。そして、二人がどこまで近づいているのか気になるのも認められる。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フォトブースストリップ I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フォトブースストリップ II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初の1枚で顔をしかめたね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君は全部で笑ってたから、やっぱり私の勝ちだと思うよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 勝つってそういうことじゃないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、最後の写真を説明してみて

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: フラッシュが光る前にキスしたじゃん 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これで永遠に残るよ。どういたしまして

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 話すのをやめて、一緒に座ってたところのことだよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたは本当に手に負えないね 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これでもまだピンボール選ぶの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。でも、今夜はずっとスコアをつけるつもりはないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それにもちゃんとスコアがあるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたのスコアは自分だけのものにしておいて

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 後で、外で

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 静かに聞こえる通りの音を忘れてた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 耳の中ではまだレースゲームをしてるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたの尊厳もどこかにあるはずだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 楽しい時間だったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君がそばにいるのがどれだけ恋しかったか、そこにいるまで気づかなかったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私が勝ったのに？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたがそれを手放さないのにね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も楽しかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し一緒に歩こうか？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。帰ったらお茶を淹れようと思ってた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それは賢い考えだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはほぼ招待状だったね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほぼ？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: お茶を飲みに来ない？君が大事なパフォーマンスの前に食べなかったお菓子もまだあるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはいいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私もそれ好きだったよ。君の肘が私の肋骨に当たった時もね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それと、セカンドコントローラーがどこにあるか聞かないでね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それには触れないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっと帰ってソファを独り占めするね😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう映画の解説が恋しい？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なんとかなるよ。本もあるし、どうやら私より先に読んでる人もいるし

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 新しい連絡先？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。君のところを出てから小さなメッセージを交換してるの

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は私が君に会ってるのを覚えてて、私が空いてるって言うまで待ってたの

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君がクッションを取りすぎてたんだよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: よかった。彼が重要なクッションの争いを邪魔するのには反対しようと思ってたから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何枚かの写真がなければ、誰も理解できなかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ドキュメンタリーがないのは残念だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私を煽らないで

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 家に帰ってきた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 本の中で自分の場所を見つけたよ。まだ店で入れてくれたしおりがあった😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あまり進んでないね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 読書より会話の方が進んでるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちゃんと答えるよ、両方できるふりはしないからね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、後でね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん ❤️ ちなみにこの写真はあなたのためだよ。彼は恥ずかしいブックマークの話をする資格なんてないからね 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その晩遅く

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 写真での答え

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたが好きそうな写真が2枚あるよ。彼も自分の写真を見せていいって言ってた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 写真を交換してたの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。これが彼が頼んだ笑顔だよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 優しくしてよ。今回はちゃんと残り物を置いてきたんだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これは彼がキッチンで撮った写真だよ。カメラの腕前を主張するつもりはないけどね😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: エプロンは彼の資格を示すためのものだったの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どうやらディナーはカメラの前で笑えなかったみたい

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それはあなたが好きそうな答えだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだったよ。気付かないふりをする前に笑っちゃった

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ところで、あなたの写真は素敵だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに気づくのはあなただって思ってたよ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに君のスプーンもね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大事にしてね。ドラマチックな再会を期待してるから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君には私に言うための2時間あったのに。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 家に容器を置いたら、{{name:aiden}}に会いに行くよ😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ゲームセンター？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん。彼は君の専門的なアドバイスを無駄にするのはもったいないって言ってたよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はその半分も知らないよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼はもう、機械の一つがコインを食べるって警告してくれたよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 便利だね。君が来る前に言い訳が準備できてる。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼にちょうど1回だけ許可するね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君がみんなを何かで非難してる間、私はそれを見ようと忙しかったんだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 優しいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼にまた会いたかったし、コーヒーでの慎重な会話よりも何かをする方が良さそうだったから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 楽しんできて！私からの説明はもういらないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいね。ソファの探偵からの指示はもう十分だよ😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕方早く、アーケードの外で

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 着いたよ🎮 ここは歩道からでも聞こえるね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼に全部のゲームを選ばせちゃダメだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼が到着したばかりで、レーシングマシンを指さしてるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そりゃそうだよね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一人については正しかったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 携帯をしまうね。運を祈ってて😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなのいらないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: アーケードの中で

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 準備万端だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 何のために？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 賢い靴だね。勝つつもりの人だ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今朝市場を歩き回った人だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 実は君に何か持ってきたんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もう慰めの賞品？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: お菓子だよ。自分でもまだ食べられるし

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その七人全員を非難した後でね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいえ、先に謝罪を受け入れるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたがいると、思いやりを持つのがすごく難しいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ありがとう。優しいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ほら。どれだけ簡単だったか分かる？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜は全ての文を監視するつもり？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うざいのだけね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それがほとんどのネタだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 即興でやらなきゃね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初のゲームの後

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最初のポイントはカウントされなかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 徹底的な探偵仕事だね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 機械はそう思ってないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 準備する前に打ったじゃん

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: これがどれだけ簡単になるか説明してたじゃん

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私は歓迎してたのよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 優しくしてくれるって言ったじゃん

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それが明らかに間違いだったね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: じゃあ、私が勝ったって認める？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次のゲームの余地はあるって認めるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいえ。あなたが最初の機械を選んだんだから、次は私が選ぶよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ゲーム終了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}}が最初のラウンドに勝った

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: なのに、私が君のペストリーの最後の一口を盗むのに気づかなかったんだね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: とても悔しがり屋

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}}の入れ知恵だな

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は、負けたらもう一回やりたくなるって言ってたよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼と話をしてくるね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のことをよく知りすぎてるってこと？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 相手チームを指導してるってこと？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 二人に手伝ってもらわなくてもパックを打てたよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そうだね。最後のシュートは良かったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ごめん、もう一回言ってくれる？機械がうるさくて。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 調子に乗るなよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 気づいたよ。君に譲ったんだ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ちょっとその瞬間を味わう時間が必要かも。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5秒だけあげるよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 君は本当に何でも数えるね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一緒に写真を撮ってもいい？彼に送るために。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もちろん。スコアボードも入る？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 入ってなかったよ。素晴らしい提案だね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: せめてもう少し負けた顔を隠す時間をくれ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そう信じることにするね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 遅すぎる。それが私が欲しい顔だよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: しばらくして

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は写真を撮ることに同意したよ。その表情は完全に彼自身の作品。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その顔、見覚えがあるよ。
