story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼は、私に警告したのを君のせいにしてるよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼に、彼の言い訳を聞くのから引退して楽しんでるって伝えて。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今回はそれは見逃してあげるね😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女が電話をしまった後

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今日の午後、ありがとう❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: そして、あなたを信じてる

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女を傷つけないってわかってるから
それは本当に大事なことだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: でも、あなたには変じゃない？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: これ全部…あなたの前で
実際、物事が楽になるよ
隠す必要なんてないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 我慢できなくて撮っちゃった😭
彼女はほとんどスポーツいらないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女は何よりもカーディオが欲しいんだ😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: うまくいったから本当に嬉しい🔥
じゃあ、ちょっとやってあげる🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女はお金の価値を感じるだろうね😂

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: ロッカールームで何かあったんだ、出るときに

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 彼女はもう少しセッションを続けたかったみたい

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: だから、彼女の面倒を見なきゃいけなかった😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: セッションが良かったの？それとも{{name:hailey}}が良かったの？😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: まさか{{name:hailey}}についてこんな会話をすることになるとは思わなかった😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: でも、変だけど…ちょっとクールだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 明日、ゲームの午後に行くよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: あなたたち二人はお互いに好意を持ってるんでしょ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ねえ😊、容器のふたを返さなきゃ。なんだかそれも持って帰っちゃったみたい😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: アーケードよりずっと静かだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 全然わからないでしょ。ほぼ聴力が戻ってきたけど、他の部分はあまり落ち着いてないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 嬉しそうだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 私は❤️ しばらく携帯を置いておこうね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 後で話そうね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼女が電話をしまった後

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: その夜遅く

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: このままいると、出るつもりだったことを忘れちゃいそう

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは偶然じゃないよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: シャツが上がっちゃってるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 気づいたよ。そこに手を置いてていいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君のせいで、先に立ち上がるのがすごく難しいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: じゃあ、もう一度キスしてから立ち上がって。今夜はベッドには連れて行かないから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 聞こうと思ってなかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君も考えてたでしょ。私もだよ。だから今言ってるの

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ソファで最後の深いキスを

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼の手は彼女の腰に、彼女の手は彼のシャツの裾の下に

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 急速に進んでいる。何が心地よいのか、これからも正直に話し合っていたい。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今夜は楽しかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 静かな部分も？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 少し後、家で

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 特にその部分。君の口。君の手。全部だよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 賢い最後の一言を言おうとしなくても、君は出て行けるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: また会いたいって言おうと思ってたんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは君が持ってていいよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 明日メッセージしてね。何か考えよう

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん、するよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それと、ペストリーの箱も持って行って。ここに置いておくと、私が残りを食べちゃうから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: とても難しい責任だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: なんだか君ならやり遂げられると思うよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼が去った後

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼は帰ったよ。私たちは予定よりずっと長くソファにいたんだ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: お茶は成功したアイデアだったね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん、すごく。おしゃべりして、近くに座って、そしたら彼を引き寄せたの。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼の手は私のトップの下に、私の手は彼のシャツの下に。キスしてたけど、今夜はこれ以上進まないって言わなきゃいけなかった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼はやっと、あなたより上手くやってるかどうか聞くのをやめた。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは大きな進展だね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 競争しないことを競争にしないでね 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 私は学んでいます

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今夜は違う感じだった。何が起こるべきかを考えようとしてる感じじゃなかった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん。うっかり彼の容器のふたを持って帰っちゃった

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼の手を私のところに置きたかったから、そこに置いたの。もう一度話す必要はなかった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それに対してリラックスしてるみたいだね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そうだよ。ちょっと赤面してる。あなたと過ごした午後が嬉しい。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: また一人だよ。素敵な夜だった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 嬉しそうだね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そうだよ。いい感じで疲れてるし、まだちょっと暖かい。ずっと時計を見て過ごさなかったことが本当に嬉しい。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 残しておきたい詳細は残してね。楽しんでくれて嬉しいよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ありがとう。寝る前にまだ少しあなたと話したいな ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君たち二人は在庫リストが必要だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: その夜遅く

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 笑顔になる理由

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: やっとアプリを置いたよ😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 本のどれかを読めた？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 少しだけ。昨日のことを話し始めてからはほとんど読めなかったし、その後は写真のことでもっと少なくなっちゃった

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼は本屋を離れたくない理由を探してるって言ってた。そして、ちゃんと私に触れたいとも言ってた

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そして、あなたは残る理由を考えてたんだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼が私のスプーンを持ってるの。交渉中だよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: その通り。あの誤解は解決したみたいだね😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今夜のメッセージはずいぶん大胆になったね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 本の話だけをしてるふりをしなくてもよかったんだ？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん。彼にまた会いたいって言ったし、話だけじゃなくてね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それから、お互いにもう少し写真を送ったよ。少し無邪気じゃないものもね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼はこの2枚を見せてもいいって言ってた。後のは彼と私の間だけのものだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 私が仲介できるよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは、何もしていないふりをしているときによく見られる笑顔だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 彼もそれに気づいた。私にはとても不便だった。ストラップは私の助けにならなかった

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: これが彼が撮って返してくれたやつだよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 二人とも会話を楽しんでるみたいだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そうだね。その後はあまり読書しなかった。最後の写真は自分のために取っておいたよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: かわいそうな本だね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 本は回復するよ。私が明日までに回復するかはわからないけど

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: メッセージで話す方が楽だった？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君は数字で表示されたスコアに異議を唱えたね。君には資格がないと思うよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: いくつかの点ではそうだね。沈黙が変に思われることを気にせずに考える時間が持てたから

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: でも、彼が何かをどう言うかを聞きたいと思ったり、ただ読むだけじゃなくて、別の写真じゃなくて彼の手が欲しいと思ったりもした

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは次のデートの理由になりそうだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そうだね。明日話して時間を決めよう

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今夜は会話を切り替えるのは終わりにするね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 寝る前に少しだけあなたと過ごしたいな❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今夜のメッセージはこれで終わり。とても素敵な夜だったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: その本はあまり注目された？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 砂糖いる？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 真剣な読者になったふりをするほどではなかったよ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 次の章に進むまで判断は保留するね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ありがとう。今夜は他の詳細は自分のために取っておくね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それで大丈夫だよ。調子はどう？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 嬉しいな。ちょっと寝るには暑すぎるけど、あなたと少し話したい気分だよ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 一つください

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それはまた訪問を手配する方法なの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 私が去った後、君の夜はどうだった？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 静かだったよ。片付けを終わらせて、少し遊んでた。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: また考え込んじゃったの？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 少しね。でも、ここに座って全てを予測しようとするより、午後の方が助けになったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 映画についてはまだ言い合ったし、君は私の食べ物を盗んだ。でも、何も無理に感じなかったよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: そうじゃなかったよ。私はちょうどいたかった場所にいたんだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: わかってるよ。君は私の前で寝そうになってたし。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それはソファへの褒め言葉だったのよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 明らかに

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ほら？好みがあるんだね。すごいね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今日はとても良い一日だったみたいだね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん、そうだよ。私が去った後、君のはどうだった？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: うん、静かだったけど、君と午後を過ごせて良かった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君が私の腕を動かそうとしてたのを思い出すよ、寄りかかりたかったのに認めなかったね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 君の肘が完全に不合理なスペースを取ってたんだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 次回はもっと便利に配置するね。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Please do. I'm a demanding guest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ぜひそうして。私はわがままなゲストだから。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今日はただの昨日の服が違うだけじゃなくて良かった。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You saved that one all the way from yesterday
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それは昨日からずっと温めてたんだね

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: それをカレンダーに入れよう。たまには他のこともしようよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 次の映画は正式にお願いしなくても、私に選ばせてくれてもいいよ。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Let's not get carried away

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 感情的な調和。自己保存。関係の不安定さ。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 時間が経つにつれて、あなたの支配的なパターンが現れるでしょう。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: パターンは持続的な不運として分類されました。最近の生活イベントをスキャン中です。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: パターンが安定するにつれて、特定の支援の形が利用可能になります。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 未来の出来事は、あなたがどのような人になるかに合わせて変わります。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 正しい道はない。あるのは結果だけだ。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: One more parameter.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: もう一つのパラメーター。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 誰を監視してほしいか選んでください。全員を選ぶことも、気になる人だけを選ぶこともできます。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: これはあなたの日常生活を変えるものではありません。私が優先することと、あなたに見せることを変えるでしょう。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 引き続きやり取りをしてください。私は背景で観察しています。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 幸運を祈ります。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: なるほど、あの不具合はこれのせいか。どうして俺のことをこんなに知っているんだ？何ができるのか確かめないと。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Physical trauma detected. Vehicle accident recorded.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 身体的外傷が検出されました。車両事故が記録されました。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Romantic instability increasing. Multiple missed opportunities with your partner due to leg injury.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: ロマンティックな不安定さが増加中。足の怪我のせいで、パートナーとの複数のチャンスを逃しています。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hostile social exchange detected. Repeated hostile interactions from {{name:mason}} detected.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 敵対的な社会的交流が検出されました。{{name:mason}}からの繰り返しの敵対的なやり取りが検出されました。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Paternal absence confirmed. No active protective authority present.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 父親の不在が確認されました。現在、保護権限はありません。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Financial pressure rising. Subject {{name:evelyn}} forced to resume employment.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 経済的圧力が高まっています。対象 {{name:evelyn}} は再び雇用を続けることを余儀なくされています。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 職場のハラスメントが未解決。責任者のマネージャーはまだ活動中。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern consistency confirmed. Negative outcomes exceed statistical expectation.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: パターンの一貫性が確認されました。ネガティブな結果が統計的期待を超えています。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: User stability threshold below baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: ユーザーの安定性閾値がベースラインを下回っています。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//ANOMALY DETECTED
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//異常を検出しました

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//SURVEILLANCE TARGETS
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//監視対象

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 第3日

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because I want to see you lose
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 君が負けるのを見たいから
準備して。すぐに行くよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re very confident for someone who hasn’t played yet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: まだプレイしてないのに自信満々だね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I slept weirdly good last night
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 昨夜は変な感じでよく眠れたよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Give me time to get ready
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 準備する時間をちょうだい
何をするかによるけど

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: おはよう❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be here
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ここにいるよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for university. And impatient for it to finish
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 大学の準備はできてるよ。早く終わってほしいな

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good luck paying attention today
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 今日は集中するの頑張ってね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You could help by behaving until lunchtime
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 昼までおとなしくしてれば助けになるよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll try
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 頑張るよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: とても安心するね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your t-shirt is ready, by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ところで、あなたのTシャツが準備できてるよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good ❤️ And I've remembered my toothbrush
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: いいね❤️ それと、歯ブラシも忘れなかったよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're set
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: じゃあ、準備完了だね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: My bag is packed and I'm trying to concentrate on getting to class
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: バッグは詰め終わって、授業に集中しようとしてるよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I packed clean clothes for tomorrow too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 明日のために清潔な服も詰めたよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I won't have any reason to rush home tonight
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: だから、今夜急いで帰る理由はないよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly what I wanted
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: それがまさに私が望んでいたことだよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. See you this afternoon, love
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私も。午後に会おうね、愛してる

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you soon ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: またすぐにね❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Having trouble?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 困ってるの？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A little. I keep thinking about this afternoon
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 少しね。今日の午後のことを考えちゃう

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're not the only one
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: あなただけじゃないよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Did my pictures have anything to do with that? 😌
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 私の写真が関係してたの？😌

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: They definitely helped
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 絶対に助けになったよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing that smile in person
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: その笑顔を直接見るのが楽しみだな

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You will. Around five, like we said
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: そうだよ。5時頃、言った通りにね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll go home after class, get my bag and come straight over
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 授業の後に家に帰って、バッグを取ってすぐに行くね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 午後早め — {{name:hailey}} と計画を立てたから、{{name:lena}} が5時に来る前に家にいるよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: These are a crime against fashion
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: これはファッションへの犯罪だよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: A few minutes later on the lane

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 迷子になったかと思ったよ
私はいつも大げさだよ
それが私の魅力の一部なんだ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: By the way, that's quite the outfit you have on
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: ところで、その服装はなかなかだね
気に入ってるって知ってたよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well everyone seems to like it
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: みんな気に入ってるみたいだね
はい、それはきれいだった
自分にそう言い聞かせてね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Your form is ridiculous by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 君のフォーム、めっちゃおかしいよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Did you just take a picture of me?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 負けた方がダレを受ける
どうなるか見てみよう
私はめっちゃ競争心が強いから
恥をかかないようにね
これは本当に苦痛だわ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Finished class. Going home for my bag, then I'm coming to you ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 授業が終わったよ。バッグを取りに帰ってから、あなたのところに行くね❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Longer than necessary, but I survived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 必要以上に長かったけど、なんとか生き延びたよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I've got something for us to snack on later too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: うん。後で一緒に食べるお菓子も用意してるよ
あなたはすべてを考えてるね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then I'll see you at five

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: LATE AFTERNOON — Back home after bowling.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 午後遅く — ボウリングの後、家に帰ってきた。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: A few minutes later in your room

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: もう変な感じになってるよ
賭けに負けたんだから

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Damn it you’re really doing it
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: くそ、ほんとにやるんだね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re sure you want to cross that line?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: その一線を越えたいの？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate moment after bowling bet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAKがボウリングの賭けの親密な瞬間の証拠をアーカイブした

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re enjoying this way too much
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: これを楽しみすぎてるね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Don’t get used to me being this obedient
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 私がこんなに従順になるのに慣れないでね
それは明らかに不正だよ
どうなるか見てみよう
{{name:hailey}}があなたのズボンのボタンを外し始める

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: If I do this you better not make fun of me after
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: これをしたら、後で私をからかわないでね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate  act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAKが親密な行為の証拠を保存しました
どれくらい大きくなるの！？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Nice to hear you say that
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: そう言ってくれて嬉しい
君はただの負けず嫌いだね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Did you just take a picture

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: それ、消した方がいいよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of continued intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAKが続く親密な行為の証拠を保存しました

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Since we got that far, you can finish in my mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: ここまで来たから、私の口で終わらせていいよ
{{name:hailey}}が君をフィニッシュさせる

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of climax during intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAKが親密な行為中のクライマックスの証拠を保存しました
私は負けず嫌いじゃないよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: And don’t talk to me until I come to you
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 私が戻るまで話しかけないでね

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: I’m a competitive person who was robbed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 私は奪われた競争心の強い人だよ
それと…その写真消して

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:lena}} is about to arrive. I have to let you go.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:lena}}がもうすぐ到着するから、切らなきゃ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Then go. Have a good evening with her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: じゃあ、行って。彼女と素敵な夜を過ごしてね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Try not to look so pleased with yourself when you open the door 😏
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: ドアを開けるとき、そんなに得意げに見えないようにしてね😏

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Sure you will. And delete that photo before she gets here.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: もちろんそうするよ。それと、彼女が来る前にその写真消してね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} は片付けるために君の部屋を出る。君は物を片付ける。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} は片付けるために君の部屋を出る。{{name:lena}} が来る前に物を片付ける。
君は正々堂々と負けたんだよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: あなたのドアの前にいるよ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 一緒に彼女のバッグを寝室に持って行く。{{name:lena}}は椅子のそばに彼女の物を置き、歯ブラシをバスルームに入れて、あなたが彼女のために残したTシャツを見つけるために戻ってくる。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: これ？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 気に入ってくれると思ったよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: そうだよ。後で使うためにここに置いておくね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: くつろいでね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: それを言ったことを後悔するかもね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: リビングで飲み物とおやつを持ってくつろいでいると、{{name:lena}}がコントローラーに気づいて手を伸ばす。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 別のレースを試してみない？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: もちろん！日曜日と同じコースでいい？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: うん。私が考えていたコーナーを見てほしいな。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 5時に — {{name:lena}} が彼女の一泊用のバッグを持ってあなたのドアに到着する。彼女を中に入れて、荷物を解く前に優しく引き寄せる。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 今度はコントローラーを持って横に傾くあなたも見れるね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: インストラクターからのコメントはなしでお願い！

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: いくつかのレースで並んで座っていると、{{name:lena}}はまだあなたの後ろでゴールするけど、難しいコーナーをもっと自信を持ってクリアするようになった。あなたはきれいなターンを指摘して、ラウンドの間にタイミングを調整するのを手伝う。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: そのコーナーは良かったよ。今回は曲がる前に減速したね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 覚えてたよ。あなたがブレーキをかけるように言ってる声が聞こえた気がする。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: そのセクションを通るのがずっと早くなったね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: あなたが全然違うトラックにいないときの方が、これをもっと楽しんでるよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ゲームの中、それともソファの上？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 両方だよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}}はコントローラーをコーヒーテーブルに置いて、あなたの方を向く。彼女はあなたにキスをして、あなたの横に寄り添い、手をあなたの腕に置く。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: これを先に置いてもいい？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: レースの合間のひととき

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: もう一回やる？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ちょっと待って。まずはここにいて。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 喜んで。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45分後 — 君は自分のコントローラーを彼女の横に置き、一緒にソファにいる。後で、{{name:lena}} は君が夕食の準備を終える間、テーブルをセットするのを手伝う。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: バッグはいいけど、あなたはダメだよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 彼女はバッグをドアのそばに置いて、あなたの腕の中に入ってくる。あなたは彼女にキスをし、片手を彼女の腰に置いたまま。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ここにいるよ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 昨夜言ったことを覚えてるんだね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 覚えてるよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: いいね。今日はそれをする時間がたっぷりあるよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 夕方 — あなたはソファで一緒に食事をし、午後のことや{{name:lena}}の木曜日の計画について話す。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}がキスしようと寄り添ってくる。君は自分の部屋に行ってドアを閉める。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜、もっと進みたい？
そうだね、寝室は防音になってるよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm taking that as a yes.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: それはイエスってことだね。
イエスだったよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君とここにいるのを楽しみにしてたんだ。
私も。特に昨日の後はね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君はベッドの端に座っている。{{name:lena}}が君の肩に腕を回してキスをする。君は彼女を近くに抱き寄せて、一緒にゆっくり過ごす。
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 明かりが消える前のキス

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜出かけることを考えなくていいのが嬉しい。
これから助けて。
こっちに来て。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 君は彼女のセーターを脱がせる手伝いをする。彼女は君が脱がせ終わるまで近くにいる。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼が彼女のセーターを頭から引き抜く。
下には黒いレースがある。
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
これから助けて
写真よりもさらに素敵。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そう言ってくれると思ってた。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She lies back on the bed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女はベッドに横たわる。
彼の手が彼女の太ももの間にある。
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
彼の手
私の番。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私もそう思う。でも、昨日送った写真のことをまだ考えてるよ。
彼女は彼の足の間にひざまずく。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女は彼を口に含む。
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
彼女の番

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: こっちに来て。君に私の中に入ってほしい。
彼が彼女の上に移動する。
最初の突き
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
彼女の中に
彼女は彼をもっと近くに抱きしめる。
もっと深く
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
もっと近く
彼は彼女の中で終わる。
彼女は彼の下にいる。
ビジュアルキャプチャが保存されました
HAK//お知らせ
まだ中に

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45分後 — 彼女はあなたが用意したTシャツに着替えた。二人は布団の中にいる。彼女はあなたに寄り添っている。
どれのこと？
今夜は素晴らしかった。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: そうだね。君と一緒で本当に幸せだよ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も。今の私たちの関係が大好き。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 私も。君とのこの数日間は完璧だった。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今夜ここにいられるのが嬉しい。
君がここにいるのも嬉しいよ。
大好きだよ。
僕も大好きだよ。
おやすみ、愛しい人。
おやすみ。よく眠ってね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: どのことか分かってるでしょ。あの小さなプレビューと、その後のやつ。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女は君に寄り添い、手を君の手に置く。君は彼女を抱きしめて、一緒に眠りに落ちる。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女は君に寄り添い、手を君の手に置く。君は彼女を抱きしめて、一緒に眠りに落ちる。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 彼女は君に寄り添い、手を君の手に置く。君は彼女を抱きしめながら彼女が眠りに落ちる。君はもう少し起きている。
ただ荷造りしてたの。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 黒いレースで荷造りして、私が何を考えているか分かっているかのように微笑んでた。
もしかしたら、そうかもね。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 効果抜群だったよ。実際にそれを見るのをずっと待ってた。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: もっとよく見えるように、あなたの部屋に行こう。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: リビングから始めて、私はキッチンをやるね。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: この家では誰かが責任を持たないとね。
あなたが言うのは面白いね。
私の瞬間を台無しにしないで。
週に一度の掃除タイム

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 本気で私が掃除してるところを写真に撮ったの？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: たまに家事をするってこと。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: あなたのコーヒーに石鹸入れるから。
とにかく、リビングは終わったよ。
それは遅い人の言い訳だね。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: もっと話したら、トイレ掃除させるよ。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: まだベッドにいるのが聞こえるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: おはよう ❤️ あのレベルクリアできた？それともコントローラーがまだ問題？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 荷物を受け取る予定だけど、その後は特にないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何かワクワクするもの入ってる？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 携帯の充電器だよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 開けるときは興奮しすぎないでね 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ラッピングは君のために取っておくよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: なんて気が利くの ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: また忙しい一日になるの？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 授業があって、その後仕事。今夜はディナーの前に帰るよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 出かける前に着替えるの？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん、仕事のものを全部持って行きたくないから

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: やっとクリアしたよ。急がない方が良かったみたい

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 君のバッグも一晩の休息を喜ぶよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは休む価値があるよ 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: バッグを変えるときは鍵を入れっぱなしにしないでね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: それは私がやりそうなことだね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 何を着るかもまだ決めてないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: どちらにしても君は素敵に見えるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、ハンサム ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 少なくともこの時間帯には準備ができてるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ほら？もういい感じだね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: コントローラーが奇跡の復活を遂げたね 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたのせいで、携帯を放っておくのが難しいよ😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 行っていいよ。今夜のディナーが素敵でありますように

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ありがとう、今日はあまり話せなくてごめんね❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 着いたら連絡するね、帰ったらまたね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大丈夫、返信は急がなくていいよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。良い一日をね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: あなたも

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大好きだよ、また後でね❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 私も愛してるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: その部分はあまり話したくないな

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: とても便利だったね 😌 その後、少し寝れた？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: うん。君はどうだった？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: まあまあ寝れたし、アラームが鳴ったときに起きれたよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 二人にとって成功した朝だね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 調子に乗らないで、まだ家を出てないから

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 後で何するの？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 今日の午後 — 君は {{name:hailey}} と計画を早めに立てて、{{name:lena}} が5時に到着する前に家に帰れるようにしている。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: じゃあ、車で待ってるね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: No point going back and forth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 行ったり来たりする意味ないし

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So what, I don’t know how to teach?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: どうしたの、教え方がわからないの？
被験者が言葉の支配に反応中
セッションがかなりオーバータイム

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: もう教えているようには思えない。嫉妬の奥にある不安を振り払えない。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAKは教授が被験者にもっと頑張るように命じた時の口の行為の始まりをキャッチした。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 私はただ、あまりにも上手すぎるだけ。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 教授に会いに行かなきゃ
じゃあ、もっと深くしてみて。
ディープスロート強制

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 被験者が混ざった抵抗と従順を示す

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: あの入り混じった反応が心配だ。報告だけじゃ、彼女が大丈夫かは分からない。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 被験者の挑発に続いて、教授がより深い挿入を強制した。被験者は muffledな反応を示した。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 私が終わるまで終わらないよ。
じゃあ、もっと頑張って。
被験者が挑戦を受け入れた
クライマックスに達した
力のダイナミクスが完全に確立された

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: でも、バスはあと1時間来ないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 被験者は教授の挑戦を受け入れ、彼をクライマックスに導いた。行為後の言葉のやり取りは、今後のセッションへの相互の期待を確認している。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 次回はちゃんと準備しておいてね。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I was stuck on the last exercise
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 最後の演習でつまずいてた。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: 15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15分後 — 君は {{name:hailey}} を家まで送った。彼女は自分の部屋に向かい、君は鍵を片付ける。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 足が大丈夫なら、送ってくれる？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ねえ❤️ 出発の準備ができたよ、鍵を別のバッグに移すのも忘れなかった

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 家に着いたら彼に知らせるって言ったでしょ
まだ家に帰ってないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかってる。それが問題じゃないの

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: マネージャーが彼女のバッグを持ってきた; {{name:lena}}が携帯を取り出す

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女は今、彼から少し離れて座り、画面を見下ろしている; 二人とも完全に服を着ている
ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今、彼女が携帯を見ている。同じ彼女からのメッセージを待っているのに、朝と同じようにその言葉を読める気がしない。
HAK//お知らせ
彼女の携帯に戻る
今夜泊まってもいいよ
いいえ、家に帰る
残念だね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 夕食は楽しかった。今考えてるのはそれだけじゃないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 争いになる必要はないよ
うん、良い夜を楽しんでね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: あなたと争ってるわけじゃない。彼に何を言うか考えてるの

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 少し一人の時間が必要なの

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: わかった。君のジャケットはドアのそばにあるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分後にバスがあるから、それに乗るね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}}が開いたアパートのドアの前に立って、ジャケットを着て肩にバッグをかけている

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: マネージャーは横に寄って、再び彼女のお尻を見ている
ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's finally leaving. I thought that would make me feel better, but now I'm dreading the message saying she's home.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: やっと帰っていく。それで楽になると思っていたのに、今は家に着いたというメッセージが怖い。
HAK//お知らせ
出発の時間だ
おやすみ、{{name:lena}}
ありがとう

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the bus ride, once she is back at her own place...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: バスに乗った後、彼女が自分の家に戻ると...
ただいま❤️ 遅くなってごめんね
あなたも ❤️
大丈夫？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I'm okay. Got back without any trouble
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: うん、大丈夫。問題なく帰れたよ
夕食は美味しかった？
はい

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to tell me about it tomorrow
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明日それについて教えてね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing big enough to make a story. I'm going to get ready for bed now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 物語になるほどのことはなかったよ。今から寝る準備をするね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh okay, I'm glad you got back all right then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ああ、よかった。無事に帰れたんだね
ごめんね..ちょっと疲れた
待っててくれてありがとう❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was still up anyway. I collected that charger, by the way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: どうせまだ起きてたし。あ、それと充電器を取っておいたよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After she puts her phone in her bag and goes inside...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼女が携帯をバッグに入れて中に入った後...
スリリングな配達？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've left the spare by the sofa for next time you're here
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次回来たときのために、ソファの横に予備を置いておいたよ
ありがとう ❤️
少し寝なよ
おやすみ❤️
愛してる
あなたも愛してる ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation is detected near {{name:lena}} inside the apartment
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: アパートの中で{{name:lena}}の近くに会話が検出されました

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said a few people from work were having dinner. I'm trying to hold on to that while I wait for the next update.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 職場の何人かで食事をすると彼女は言っていた。次の知らせを待ちながら、その言葉にすがろうとしている。
HAK//ライブトランスクリプション

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There you are. You look good
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: やっと見つけた。いい感じだね
もちろん、いい感じだよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm appreciating the effort. Much better than yesterday's paperwork
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: その努力を評価してるよ。昨日の書類仕事よりずっといい
それはかなり低い基準だね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't looking at the paperwork much either
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私も書類はあまり見てなかったよ
信じて、気づいてたよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me take your jacket. You can put your bag on that chair
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ジャケットを預かるよ。その椅子にバッグを置いていいよ
ありがとう。いい匂いがするね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Try not to sound so amazed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: そんなに驚いた声を出さないでよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager takes {{name:lena}}'s jacket as she sets her bag on the chair by the entrance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: マネージャーが{{name:lena}}のジャケットを取り、入口の椅子にバッグを置く

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dining table behind them is set for two; no other guests are present
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彼らの後ろのダイニングテーブルは二人分用意されていて、他の客はいない
ビジュアルキャプチャがアーカイブされた

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A table for two, after I asked if it was a group thing and she told me it was. I keep reading that message as if it might change.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 二人用のテーブル。皆で行くのかと聞いて、そうだと言われたのに。変わるはずもないメッセージを何度も読み返している。
HAK//お知らせ
二人用のテーブル

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At the table, once he has served dinner...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: テーブルで、彼がディナーを出したら...
どう？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could let me finish chewing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 噛むのを終わらせるまで待ってくれてもいいのに

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already know whether it's good
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: もうそれが美味しいかどうか知ってるでしょ
美味しいよ
君は美しいよ
よし、これで

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you need applause too, or can I keep eating?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 拍手も必要？それとも食べ続けていい？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me what you think of the sauce next
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 次はソースについてどう思うか教えてね
レモンとニンニク？
それとバター。特に神秘的なものはないよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I expected a speech about a secret family recipe
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 家族の秘密のレシピについてのスピーチを期待してたんだ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can make one up if you need an impressive story
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 印象的な話が必要なら、私が作ってあげるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you've done enough self-promotion for one meal
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: いいえ、もう十分自己宣伝してるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you've stopped looking as though you're here for a meeting
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: それに、会議のためにここにいるみたいな顔はやめたね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食べ物があるし、スプレッドシートの話もしてない。助かるよ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I changed my mind twice before putting this on
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ありがとう❤️ これを着る前に二回も気が変わったよ
君がここにいる方がいいな
どこと比べて？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Across my desk, pretending you're only listening because I pay you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 私のデスクの向こうで、私が払ってるから聞いてるふりをしてるんでしょ

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At work, that is usually why I'm listening
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 仕事では、そういう理由で聞いてることが多いよ
じゃあ今夜は？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying to enjoy dinner
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今夜はディナーを楽しもうとしてるんだ
本当にそうだね

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.
